༄༅/ /dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bskyed rim mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bskyed

rim mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa bzhugs/ oṃ na mo gu ru guh+ya sa ma dzaḥ tsakra saṃ bha ra/ mahā ma ya/ badz+ra bhai ra ba/ mahā' kā la maṇ+ḍal le bh+yaḥ slob dpon ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /'dul dka' 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur bstan pa/ / rnam lnga'i dkyil 'khor mchog la mgos btud nas/ /bla med sgrub thabs gang yin gsal bar bri/ /lam 'dir mkhas grub dam pa mchog brnyes pa'i/ /skyes bu du mas yang yang bshad gyur mod/ /mtshar sdug lang tshos sgeg pa'i gzugs bzang mar/ /rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan na lhag par mdzes/ / de la dgyes pa rdo rje drag po gdan can gyi bskyed pa'i rim pa la gzhi byas nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa'i tshul ni 'di yin te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas spyi dang mthun par byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang gi snying gar thim nas zhu ba'i thig le las/ bdag ny-id dgyes pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang dbang phyug gi gdan la gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ de las khro bo bcu spros phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar du gshin rje gshed nag po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma'i mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gtum po nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngo dmar lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du be con sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du stobs po che nag po tri shu la 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po gtun shing 'dzin pa/

mi g.yo 'dod rgyal gnod mdzes rnams rol pa'i khro bo/ gzhan rnams shin tu khros pa/ thams cad kyang stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ khro bo'i mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa me dpung dang bcas pa'o/ / khro bo bcu las khro bo bcu lcags kyu dang zhags pa phyogs bcur spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams kyi yan lag lnga zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus snying gar btab ste bkug par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta hū?ṃ/ oṃ pad+man+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ bigh+nan kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ ār+yā tsa la hūṃ/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza hūṃ/ oṃ ni la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ oṃ mahā ba la hūṃ/ oṃ tsakra wārti hūṃ/ oṃ sum+bha rā dza hūṃ/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ gṛ+-ih+ṇa pā ya gṛ+-ih+ṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha gi wān bid+yā rā dza hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yang hūṃ las phur bu dang tho ba bcu spros/ yang sprul khro bo rnams kyi lag pa g.yas g.yon du gtad/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab cing tho bas brdungs nas/ lus g.yo 'gul med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ sems 'od gsal du thim zhing lhag ma rnams rdo rje'i me 'od dang dang sngags kyi sgras khor yug chen po'i phyi rol tu bskrad par gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+tā na phaṭa/ kī lā ya kī lā ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī la badz+ra dha ro a dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ga ra badz+ra kī la ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rang nyid mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas mā ma kī la 'khyud pa/ rlung kha sbyor bya/ rtsa gsum gsal btab nas/ a wa dhū ti rab tu rgyas pa'i nang gi snying gar hūṃ mthing nag /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ snying ga'i hūṃ las raṃ chad de 'og tu nyi mar gyur/

yang hūṃ gcig chad de/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur pa ni/ shar gyi rā gsum dkar po/ lho'i rwa gsum ser po/ nub kyi rwa gsum dmar mo/ byang gi rwa gsum ljang khu/ lte ba mthing nag la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje de nyid rgya che zhing rngams 'thug par gyur pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug tu 'phros pa dpangs mtho nas rwa ba/ rtse mo rnams steng du 'dus pas gur dang bla bre/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phyogs bzhir dmigs nas hūṃ bzhi pa lan gcig brjod/ snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyi sna la rdo rje gcig pa nas rtse dgu pa'i bar gyi rdo rje rnams 'phros te go mtshams med pa gtams/ yang rak+ṣa 'i sngags brjod pas/ 'og gi nyi ma las ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi me 'bar bas phyi ngos kyi rdo rje rnams khro chu ltar zhu nas/ me long gi ngos bzhin du gyur pas bskal ba'i rlung gis kyang mi thar zhing bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i bsrung 'khor ye shes kyi me 'bar bas dpag tshad bye ba tsam du khyab par gyur/ badz+ra rwak+ṣa'i sngags lan gsum brjod/ gnas bsrungs pa'o/ / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la/ /rtag tu gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / lan gsum rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/ /lus bsrung ba ni/ bla ma yi dam 'khor bcas kyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sems can gyi don du rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs sgrub pa ni shin tu legs so/ / rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bar chad nga yi bsrung zhing byin gyis brlabs par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad pa bkrus par gyur/

dngos su khrus spro na bya/ ngag bsrung ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje la sogs pa byon nas rang dang dbyer med du gyur/ yang sngags rnams bzla zhing kha bkrus la bdud rtsi myang*/ yid bsrung ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi pha ma yin/ pha ma 'di rnams sdug bsngal ba snying re rje/ da ni bdag gis bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis go 'phang la bzhag par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bgyi'o/ / bdag bsrung ba'o/ / de yan chad ni dkyil 'khor re re nyams su len pa dag gis/ dgyes pa rdo rje dang rgyud sde lnga zhes bya ba'i gnas su rang rang gi mtshan bcug pas 'grub cing gzhan rnams la phyag gnyis pa rang gi mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar bsgoms zhing*/ gsang 'dus la yang rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po yum can bsgom pa yin no/ /de nas rang skad cig gis dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pas gsal ba'i snying gar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad sbyangs/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ yang 'phros pas sha khrag la sogs pa bar gyi dngos po rnams kyang sbyangs te ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ yang 'phros pa ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir song ste rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkyil 'khor lnga'i lha tshogs bla mas dbu brgyan pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs/ /bdag gi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ bha ga wan mahā kā ru ṇi he badz+ra gu he sa mā dzaḥ

tsakra sam+bhar mahā/ māha ma yā badz+ra bhai ra ba maṇ+ḍal la sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs sh+lo ka gcig /bcom ldan dgyes mdzad dkyil 'khor dang*/ /gsang 'dus mahā ma ya dang*/ /bde mchog 'khor lo 'jigs mdzad de/ /yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ / dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /chos skyong tshogs dang bcas pa la/ / bdag sogs gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ni ri ti hūṃ khaṃ/ ne wi te hūṃ khaṃ/ sarba saṃ shwa dha ni ā hūṃ*/ dzaḥhūṃ? baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ mahā ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ yang na/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ pat+yaṃ ste chu gnyis phul kyang rung*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis 'bul/ nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje skye ba snying rje can/ /rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi/ /lha mo brgyad po rnams kyis mchod/ /dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma ri ni sman 'dzin cing*/ /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod mi ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /mchod bya yul/ mchod byed bdag / mchod pa'i rdzas thams cad rang bzhin med par rang gis sems nyid do/ / de nas rgyun bshags ni/ thog med dus kyi sdig pa dang*/ /sems can rnams kyi sdig pa'i tshogs/ /mi dge las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed la bshags par bgyi/ /so sor thar pa'i mi mthun dang*/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /de dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa kun/ /de dag khyed la so sor bshags/ /gsang sngags theg par dbang bskur nas/ /dam tshig nyams chags byung ba kun/ /de dag khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /mi dge slan chad sdom par bgyi/

/so so'i skye bo'i dge ba dang*/ /nyan thos dgra bcom dge ba dang*/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi dge ba la/ /bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /'gro don 'phrin las rab rgyas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /dge ba kun la yi rang ngo*/ /bla ma yi dam lha rnams kyi/ / gsang sngags lam mchog mtha' ru phyin/ /'bras bu sku bzhi 'grub pa yi/ /dge ba kun la yi rang ngo*/ /bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob don du/ /byang chub chen por rab tu bsngo/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas la/ /bdag gis lus ngag yid gsum ni/ /ltos med sems can don du 'bul/ khyed kyi sku gsum 'grub par shog /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang*/ /'du 'bral med par 'grub gyur nas/ khyed kyi byin rlabs mthu yis ni/ /gang ltar song yang thugs rjes zungs/ /bla ma rgyud sde'i lha rnams kyis/ /sems can rgyud la gang 'tshams pa'i/ /gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ / bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas kyis/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ / sangs rgyas sa la ma 'khod bar/ /de srid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bla ma dam pa rnams dang ni/ /yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /bla ma rgyud sde'i lha rnams kyis/ /dang po byang chub thugs bskyed ltar/ /bdag kyang sems can bsgral ba'i blos/ khyed kyi rjes su sems bskyed do/ / yang na mtsho skyes ltar yan lag lnga'am/ gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya'o/ /de nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad la sogs pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung bar bya'o/ / sems can thams cad bde ba dang*/ sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ / oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swā bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma la hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las rdo rje'i sa gzhir rwa ba drwa bgur bla bre me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing*/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gaṃ yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ dang 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ baṃ dang bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laṃ dang rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu drug pa lte ba la bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu las drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa la sogs pa du ma dpyangs pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dabs las thur du 'phyang ba'i shar bu'i phreng ba dang*/ steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyibs can gyis bskor ba'i bar bar na gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mo rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'gram stegs mchod pa'i snam bu dmar po la bud med sgyu ma'i mdzes sdug gis sgeg pa'i gzungs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa/ zur bzhir zla phyed nor bu dang*/ sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/

sgo bzhi'i mdun du rgyan dang bcas pa'i ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs mchod rten gyis rnam pa can ngang pa dang rma bya dang nya spus brgyan pa dang*/ chu srin dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ spre'u bzung ba'i ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ rta babs kyis rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos 'khor/ steng du gdugs dkar po/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gzhal yas khang glang rgyab kyi nang de bzhin gshegs pa lngas mdzes pa/ sgo bzhi'i phyi rol tu rin po che'i them skas dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu babs bzhon gyi rta babs dang bcas pa'o/ / de'i phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ byang du tshang tshang 'khrigs pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa mi zad pa/ nub byang du ca co sgrog pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa'o/ /shing chen po brgyad ni/ ha ra tsu ta a sho ka /a shwad tha dang ka rañja/ dza la ti dang par ti pa/ bhe ta dang ni bha ṭa'o/ /rtsa bar phyogs skyong brgyad gnas pa/ /shar du brgya byin lhor gshin rje/ /chu lha nub dang gnod sbyin byang*/ /byang shar 'byung po shar lho me/ /lho nub srin po nub byang rlung*/ /brgya byin dkar po glang po'i bdag

/rdo rje dril bu g.yas dang g.yon/ /gshin rje mthing nag ma he bzhon/ /dbyug pa thod pa de bzhin no/ /chu lha dkar pos chu srin mnan/ /sbrul zhag g.yas dang g.yon pad+ma/ /gnod sbyin ser po rta la bzhon/ /dpal 'bras ne'u le g.yas dang g.yon/ /'byung po'i bdag po dkar po ni/ khyu mchog dkar po mdung thung 'dzin/ /me lha dmar po ra la bzhon/ /spyi blugs dbyug gu rtse gsum bsnams/ srin po kham nag me ri khrid/ /gri dang thod pa g.yas dang g.yon/ /rlung lha dud kha sha ba bzhon/ /g.yas nas ba dan zhags pa g.yon/ /thams cad rin chen brgyad ldan te/ /srin po rus pas brgyan pa'o/ /chung ma bu 'khor phyogs mdog bcas/ /mdog rnams zhi byed phyogs logs skyong*/ /steng gi nam mkhar lha chen brgyad/ /shar du brgya byin sngon dnga'adra/ /lho ru tshangs pa gser gyi mdog/ spyi blugs dbyug gu rtse gsum 'dzin/ /nub tu khyab 'jug dmar po ste/ /'khor lo g.yas dang g.yon na dung*/ /byang du lha chen thal ba'i mdog /rtse gsum thod pa g.yas dang g.yon/ /dbang ldan gzhon nu drug gi bu/ /dkar po mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa*/ /shar lho tshogs bdag dkar po ni/ /g.yas g.yon la phug la du 'dzin/ /bden bral bh+riṃ gi ri ti smug /mdung dang ba dan g.yas dang g.yon// rlung du legs ldan nag po ni/ /ral gri g.yas dang phub ni g.yon/ /thams cad lha rgyan dag dang ldan/ /lha dang gza' skar 'khor gyis bskor/ / bsdu na brgya byin dkar po man chad nas 'di'i bar bor kyang rung ngo*/ / chu la klu chen brgyad gnas pa/ / 'jog po dung skyong rigs ldan dang*/ /mtha' yas pad chen dga' bo dang*/ / nor rgyas bu dang pad+ma rnams/ /phyogs skyong mdog can sbrul zhags dang*/ /pad+ma 'dzin cing gdengs ka ldan/ /shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong rnams phyogs skyong so so'i mdog dang mtshungs shing so so'i bzhon pa'i gdong pa can gri gug dang thod pa gtor mas gang ba 'dzin pa'o/

/ sprin chen po brgyad ni/ sgrog byed ser po ldog byed sngon po/ 'jigs byed dkar po/ 'khor byed ser po/ 'thug po dkar po/ 'gengs byed dmar po/ char 'bebs nag po/ gtum po ljang gu'o/ /gzhan yang ri brgyad mchod rten brgyad/ chu brgyad/ drag tu 'bar ba'i me brgyad dang bcas pa/ bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs 'thab pa dang 'khrugs pa dang nga ro 'don pa/ grub chen rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i slob dpon rnams dang*/ 'jigs pa dang 'dzem pa med pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma cang te'u dang kha ṭ+wāṃ thogs te ha ha zhes gar bsgyur ba/ rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra dang*/ 'dod chags kyi rnam par rol ba/ mtshan dang ldan pa'i bu mo rnams gcer bu skra grol ba/ rnam par grol ba/ rnam par brgyan pa/ gar gyi rol ba sna tshogs pas thod rnga'i sgra dang*/ glu dbyangs bro cha dang bcas pas lhang lhang sogs sgrog pa dang*/ la lar 'byung po/ sgron me 'bar ba'i 'jug ngogs nas/ lce spyang khus 'debs pa dang*/ phag dang seng ge dang*/ stag dang khyi dang*/ wa sna tshogs pas gang zhing*/ khwa dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ bya rog dang*/ 'ol ba dang mchu ring la sogs pas lang long du rgyug pa/ seng ge'i gdong can dang*/ stag gi gdong can dang*/ sbrul ba glang gi mgo can dang*/ mgo gnyis pa la sogs pa skyi g.ya' ba/ ro phyed tshig pa dang*/ dum bu dang*/ 'thor ba dang*/ 'gags te shing la dpyangs pa dang*/ lhu dum dang mgo bo dang*/ keng rus kyis khyab pas yid 'byung bar byed pa/ ro langs dang mgo med rnams gar byed pa/ gnod sbyin dang srin po dang sha za dang 'byung po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams g.yo ba dang*/ 'greng ba dang*/ sdod pa dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ za ba dang*/ rgyug pa la sogs pa sna tshogs pas ngo mtshar bskyed pa/ grub pa'i rdzas dang mchod rdzas thams cad kyi gang ba'i dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod/ de rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi lha snam shar dkar/

lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ phyogs bzhi dmar ba/ me dang rlung ser ba/ bden bral ljang ba/ dbang ldan sngo ba/ mtha' ma rdo rje nag po'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba/ lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la bdud bzhi'i ngo bo/ tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang ljang khu/ drag po nag po rnams gan rkyal du bkram pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa/ lho ru brgya byin/ nub tu nye dbang*/ byang du drag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor gnod sbyin ser po/ lho nub tu srin po smug naganub byang du lha min thags bzang ris ljang khu rnams gan rkyal du gnas pa'i/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ sgo bzhir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yi dwags kyi gdan re re'o/ / 'di man ngag ste/ gzhung nas gtso bo la 'dud bzhi'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan gsungs pa ltar byas kyang rung ngo*/ / dbus su rang sems hūṃ dang oṃ nag po/ de'i 'og tu mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ḍa dha da dha la ya/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gnyis zhugs te/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa dang aṃ las gri gug aṃ gis mtshan par gyur pa ni so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs chos kyi dbyings kyis ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog mthing nag

/zhal brgyad pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal nas hūṃ spro ba/ lha dang lha min thams cad bsdigs par mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs pa/ drag po chen po rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba steng zhal du ba'i mdog can/ lhag ma zhal bzhin nag pa/ dbu skra ser po 'bar zhinga'akhyil ba/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu brgyan can smin ma yon po dang bcas shing*/ khro gnyer ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ban+dhu ltar dmar pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na 'khor lo/ lnga pa na bshor/ drug pa na dbyug pa/ bdun pa na rtse gsum/ brgyad pa na lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lnga pa na thod pa/ drug pa ni rin po che/ bdun pa na sdigs 'dzub/ brgyad pa na zhags pa bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang gi stabs dang*/ rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis tshangs pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ drag po dang*/ nye dbang rnams mnyam par mnan/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de la 'khyud pa'i bdag med ma nag po drag mo chen po lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ phyag bzhi'i dngapo gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang mgo bo skam po lnga'i phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rjes su chags pa/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing nam mkha'i mtha' klas par 'od kyis khyab par mdzad pa'o/

/ yang na zhabs mdun ma gar stabs/ rgyab ma g.yas brkyang pa'o/ / yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa tsa tur ā nan+ta dā ya ka kha kha mu kha e ka ra so na tha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba aṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra mahā rā ga su kha da da tsa tur a nan+ta bhā ga bi shwa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs yab kyi zhal nas zhugs nas thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pas thig le cha bcu gnyis su gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ so so'i gdan la 'khod pa nyi zla kha sbyor bcu gnyis su gyur/ de rnams kyi bar du gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ṭaṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gri gug dang cang te'u ral gri dang thod pa rin po che dang rdo rje rlung ras dang thod pa lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa lcags sgrog dang dril bu rnams sa bon de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ zla nyi so so dang gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gnyis gri gug dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub tu bai ta li ser mo g.yas gnyis ral gri dang chang bu/ g.yon gnyis dung chos dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma ri ljang gu g.yas gnyis thod zhags dang skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gnyis dgra s+t+wa dang me thab 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon po g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang mchog sbyan/ /g.yon gnyis dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor shā bā ri dkar mo g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

/g.yon gnyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu tsan+d+ra lī sngon po g.yas gnyis rlung ras dang thod pa/ g.yon gnyis ba dan dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ḍoṃ bi ni sna tshogs mdog g.yas gnyis thod pa dang bshor/ g.yon gnyis mdung rtse gsum dang sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ shar sgor rta gdong ma nag mo zhal bzhi nag ser dmar ba'i steng na rta gdong ljang khu rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gling bu/ tha ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhor sgor phag gdong ma ser mo zhal bzhi ser sngo dkar ba'i steng na phag gdong dmar mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis pi wang tha ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang zhags pa 'dzin pa nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo zhal bzhi dmar sngo dkar ba'i steng na khyi gdong ser mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rnga bo che/ tha ma gnyis kyis pad+ma dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang gu zhal bzhi ljang nag dmar ba'i steng na seng gdong dkar mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdza rnga/ tha ma gnyis kyi ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sgo ma rnams ni stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ rtsa zhal yang steng zhal dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de nas/ gtso bo'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ gtsug tor dang ltai bar hoḥ dmar po res mtshan par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas bdud bzhi'i steng du/ de ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin thig le gnyis su gyur/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i lha mo bzhi'i snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i don la bskul ba ni/

puk+ka sis/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhin bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ / sha ba rīs/ khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras 'grub par mdzod/ / tsan+ḍā lis/ dga' brtse 'jig rten don gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol ba mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ / ḍoṃ bi nis/ bdag gis nyid kyi thugs 'chal gyi/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces bskul bas/ thig le gnyis po gcig tu 'dres te nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūṃ dang aṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūṃ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag sogs rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yum bcas ltar gsal btab/ mtshon cha can gyi dkyil 'khor kho na bsgom par 'dod na 'og nas 'byung ba'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren yan chad bya'o/ /rgyud sde lnga bsgom par 'dod na/ de ltar bdag nyid dgyes mdzad du gyur pa'i sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa'i lte ba la nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan/ 'dab ma rnams la shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang ljang khu/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po dmar po/ nub byang du thags bzang ris ljang khu/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog nag po/ drag po chen po rtsa ba'i zhal nag po g.yas dkar g.yon dmar steng zhal du ba'i mdog can/

lhag ma bzhi nag po/ dbu skra ser po 'bar zhing 'khyil ba/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan can smin ma yon po dang bcas shing*/ khro gnyer ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ban+dhu ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa brgyad na/ glang po che rta/ bong bu glang*/ rnga mo/ khyi/ mi/ ma he rnams so/ / g.yon pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo/ chu lha/ me lha/ rlung lha/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ gshin rje/ gnod sbyin rnams so/ /sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang gi stabs dang*/ rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyi tshangs pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ drag po dang*/ nye dbang rnams mnyam par mnan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa/ de la 'khyud pa'i bdag med ma nag mo/ drag mo chen po lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang*/ mgo bo skam po'i phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rjes su chags pa/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs shing*/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /

shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug dang g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor chom rkun ma dmar mo g.yas ḍā ma ru g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu ro langs ma ser mo g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du za nus ma ljang gu g.yas sbrul g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sbos mo sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol ba mo sngon po g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo bya ko li'i mgrin pa ltar kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga ldan/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dkar po 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang dbus ling tshe dgu pa snam bu rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa/ dbus dang khro bcu'i gnas su nyi gdan/ shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma ki la rdo rje/ gzhan lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du dgyes mdzad kyi sku'i snang ba las grub pa'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ dbus su mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khyud rgyas yum reg bya rdo rje ma rang dang 'dra ba/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khyud rgyas yum reg bya rdo rje ma rang dang 'dra ba/

pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ re mig rnams su shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje pad dkar/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu nor bu ral gri 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyi nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang po dril bu dkur bsten pas pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yas kyi dang pos kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyi rdo rje dang 'khor lo g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du don grub ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma ki sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo at+pal sngo dmar g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang pos dril bu dkur bsten pas ut+pal dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yas kyi dang pos kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo ut+pal sngon po rdo rjes mtshan pa/

g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo sangs rgyas spyan ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis me long dmar po 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo mā ma kī dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis pi wang sngon po 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ byang shar du rdo rje ma ljang gu sgrol ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ro drug gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ rim pa gsum pa'i lha snam la/ shar sgo'i g.yas su byams pa rnam snang dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas kyi dang pos klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon du sa'i snying po rnam snang dang 'dra ba/ lho sgo'i g.yas su phyag na rdo rje dang*/ g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu/ nub sgo'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ g.yon du 'jam dpal 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba/ byang sgo'i g.yas su sgrib pa rnam sel dang*/ g.yon du kun tu bzang po don grub lta bu/ lha yab rnams thams cad ral ba'i thor tshugs dang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa/ yum rnams dbu skra phyed bcings su byas pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ zur gyis lta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i dga' bas rol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung dang*/ gzhan rnams sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ thams cad dar gyi na bza' dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ / shar sgaur gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gis g.yas pa rnams kyis tho ba 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/

lho sgor shes rab 'thar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis pad+ma ral gri gtun shing*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pa'i dril bu dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyi sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing*/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lho'i grwar mi g.yo ba nag po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ / g.yon sdigs mdzub dgra sta zhags pa/ lho nub kyi grar 'dod rgyal sngon po rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya can/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon zhags pa dang lcags kyu/ nub byang gi grar dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma dgra sta/ byang shar gyi grwar stobs po che sngon po don 'grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs dkar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa rtse gsum dgra s+t+wa/ steng gi ya phugs kyi nang du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya/

lhag ma g.yas rdo rje dang pad+ma/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang ral gri/ 'og tu sa gzhi'i nang du gnod mdzes nag po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma ral gri/ khro bo thams cad kyang stobs chen pha rol gnon pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ dus mtha'i me lta bu'i me stag 'bar ba dang bcas pas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'o/ /mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa la/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i gsung gi snang ba las byung ba'i sgyu 'phrul chen mo lhar lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal he ru ka sngon po sngo ser dmar ljang pa'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo dmar ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ khro chags sgeg la 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad la/ spyan gsum gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/ skra ser gyen brdzes thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ phyag rgya lnga dang gar dgus rol ba/ thal chen gyis byugs shing mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs can g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis nyi ma'i steng du mi ro'i snying gar mnan pa me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rdo rje dril bu kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa bsnams pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rin chen ce spyang ba dan mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/

nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar dmar dkar ser ljang sngo ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis pad+ma thod pa gzhu dang mda' bsnams pa/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis ral gri zhags pa ka pā la ḍā ma ru bsnams pa/ lha mo lnga ni thal ba dang bral ba thod skam gyi phreng ba can no/ / yang na/ 'di la gzhal yas khang gi lte bar pad+ma dmar po bsgom kyang rung*/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ser po rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i steng du rin po che'i sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar*/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma'i mu khyud can/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ gsum ga'ang rtsibs brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus su bde chen 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng ba can/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i yon tan gyi snang ba las grub pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing ga g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re la dmar zhing g.yo ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags rlon stod g.yogs su gyon pa/ lhag ma g.yas rnams kyis ḍā ma ru dgra sta rtse gsum gri gug /g.yon pa rnams kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/

g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol shing phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ gar gyis nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub g.yon khrag chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum drag mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang mgo phreng gis brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ khrag la dgyes shing zla mtshan dang bcas pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma rnams la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar po/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i dngapo gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa/ 'og pa gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa ste/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni ro'i gdan dang bcas pa/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma la bum pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pu l+li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ byang phyogs dza lan+dha rar ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya nār kaṃ ka la 'od ldan ma/

lho phyogs urbu twar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lhor go da bā rir su ra bai ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub tu rasmi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po'o/ / gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kā ma rū par aṃ ku ri dang e ra ba ti/ byang phyogs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub phyogs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lhor ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang*/ sh+ye ma de bī/ lho nub lam pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang kañcir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ byang shar hi ma lar mig mi bzang dang khā gā na ste gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po'o/ / sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang phyogs gṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub phyogs so raṣ+tar rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi ni/ lho phyogs su war+ṇa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lhor na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo'i bsgyur ma/ byang shar ku la tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams zhal gcig phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang rang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og pa gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/

rgyan dang cha lugs bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ste phag mo dang rnam pa mtshungs te/ 'on kyang phyag g.yas pa na gri gug dang g.yon thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /

gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo ljang khu rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi steng du gzhal yas khang dbus kyi lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje/ steng thog re mig dgur phub pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i 'phrin las kyi snang ba las grub pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag sum cu so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa/ rtsa zhal nag po ma ge'i gdong can shin tu khros pa/ pheṃ ka ra'i sgra chen po 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ de'i steng na srin po'i zhal dmar po bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ de'i steng na 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po 'dzum zhing cung zad khros pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan can/ rwa'i g.yas phyogs kyi zhal dang po sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa ser po ste mnga' bdag gi zhal gsum shin tu khros pa/ rwa'i g.yon phyogs kyi zhal dang po dkar po gnyis pa dud kha/ gsum po nag po ste zhal gsum ka'ang mche ba gtsigs pa'o/ khro zhal rnams smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag bcu drug gis rim pa bzhin du/ dang po na gri gug /gnyis pa na 'phang mdung*/ gsum pa na gtun shing*/ des 'grel/ chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ dgra sta/ mdung*/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'khor lo/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ rdo rje tho ba/ ral gri/ rnge'u chung*/ bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi phyag bcu drug gis rim pa bzhin du/ dang po na thod khrag /gnyis pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ gsum pa na phub/ des 'gres/ rkang pa/ rdo rje'i zhags pa/ /gzhu rgyu ma/ rdo rje dril bu/ lag pa*/ ro ras/ skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ me thab/ thod tshal/ sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ rlung ras bsnams pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyis glang po'i che'i lpags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa brgyangs nas na bza' 'dzin pa/ phyag dang po gnyis phyag mtshan thugs dkar steng 'og tu 'dzin cing*/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ / zhabs bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad bskums pa rim pa bzhin du mi dang ma he dang glang dang bong bu dang rnga mong dang*/ khyi dang lug dang wa rnams mnan pa/ g.yon brgyad brkyangs pas rim pa bzhin du bya rgod dang 'ug pa dang khra dang bya rog dang ne tso dang khyung dang ri skeg dang bzhad rnams mnan pa/ de rnams kyis 'og tu tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams bsgyel zhing kha bub tu mnan pa/ dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi zo ris rnams kyis mtshan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ / de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ g.yon khrag chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum drag mo bskal ba'-i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ gcer bu skra ser 'khyil ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang rlon bral gy-i mgo 'phreng gis cod pan dang do shal du brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis yab la 'khril ba/ khro mo'i cha lugs rdzogs pa 'od kyis nam mkha'i mthar khyab pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o/ / shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/

phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshedaljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar lhor tsar tsi kā dkar mo gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lho nub tu phag mo ser mo dbu'i steng du phag zhal gyen du lta ba dang bcas pa ser sna gshin rje gshed lta bu/ nub byang du dbyangs can ma dmar mo 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ byang shar du gau ri ljang khu phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu/ de ltar lha mo bzhi po rang snang gi thabs la 'khyud pa'o/ / shar sgor thob pa gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho sgor dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ nub sgor pad+ma gshin rje gshed dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/

lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa smin ma dang sma ra dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul gyi rgyan dang stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ yab rnams thams cad thod skam lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ yum rnams thod skam lngas bu brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyi'i grwa bzhir ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ / rang dgyes mdzad rdo rje mtshon cha can gyi thugs kar pad nyi la hūṃ/ lha mo bcu gsum gyi thugs kar pad zla la/ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rnams 'khod par gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ shar phyogs kyi dur khrod chen po'i thad kyi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis yang dag par mchod/ spros na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs la 'bul/ bsdu na dgyes mdzad snying po lan gnyis dang*/ gtso bo gzhan bzhi'i snying po lan re brjod la/ mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul / de thams cad kyang sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med par shes par byas nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag

/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra be tā li ban+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasmi rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan lnga/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dam tshig sems dpa' ro gcig tu gyur/ phyi'i dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i lha rnams kyi mig tu maṃ dkar po/ rna bar daṃ sngon po/ sna la paṃ ser po/ lce la raṃ dmar po/ dpral bar iṃ ljang gu/ lte bar naṃ nag po/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ lte bar bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje ma drug gi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te skye mched kyi lha rnams la thim pa las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'jigs mdzad kyi lha rnams kyi mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar po sa'i snying po/ rna bar dzaṃ nag po phyag na rdo rje/ sna la khaṃ ser po nam mkha'i snying po/ lce la gaṃ dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug /dpral bar skaṃ ljang gu sgrib pa rnam sel/ lte bar saṃ sngon po kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo/ sgrub chen mo'i lha tshogs rnams la dpral bar rtse ser po/ mig tu oṃ dkar po/ rna bar āḥ dmar po/ kha la khe dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ snying gar ra dmar po/ bde mchog gi lha yab rnams kyi snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swā hā hūṃ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bau ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka /mig gnyis su oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa hiṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum rnams la lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po rdo rje phag mo/

snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar oṃ hrī mo dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyed byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ de ltar go cha so sor dgod pa ni bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes yin la/ grub chen khyung po nyid kyi dgongs pa ni/ dgyes mdzad lha dgu'i mig tu maṃ dkar nas/ lte bar naṃ nag po'i bar gong bzhin no/ /phyi dkyil ma gtogs kyi lus dkyil lnga car skad cig bskyed pa yin pa'i phyir/ skye mched byin gyis rlabs pa dang gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs pa mi bzhed do/ /de phyir sa bon las lus dkyil dkyil 'khor lnga'i lha tshogs bskyed pa yang mi mdzes so/ / lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ oṃ la thim pa las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ āḥl thim pa las gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs dkar hūṃ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi yid kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ hūṃ la thim pa las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa lha mo drug dang*/ sku rdo rje ma la sogs pa lha mo drug ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa dang mi mgo'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ / rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer sna lnga 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul/

dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo rig ma dngabacas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod pa gsum gyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ / gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po khyod/ /las rnams thams cad grub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur gyur/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas byung ba'i spyan ma dang*/ mā ma ki dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bsrung ba'i las mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blang*/ rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod de/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad la dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum dang*/ gau rī dang*/ puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau ri dang*/ sha wa rī dang sgo ma bzhi rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā li dang tsan+d+ra lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍoṃ bi ni la 'od dpag med rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ sgo ma bzhi la don grub kyis dbu rgyan pa yang bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bzhed pa ltar yang rung ngo*/ /de ltar phyag len la lus kyi lha rnams la yang rig bdag bzhed pa ltar na 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thams cad la rnam snang*/

sgyu 'phrul chen po'i lha tshogs thams cad la 'od dpag med/ dgyes mdzad kyi lha tshogs thams cad la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs thams cad la rin po che rgyal po/ 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs thams cad la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ ces bzhed pa ni/ sku gsang ba 'dus pa zhes gsungs pa sogs la brten pa yang snang mod kyi grub chen khyung pos mi bzhed cing don la yang mi dgos mod/ 'jag bsam kun gyi phyag len la mgrin gcig tu mdzad pa'i phyir bkod pa'o/ / de nas bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛ ta hūṃ gi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po stong gsum gyi khyon tsam gyi nang du/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūṃ las snabs dang mchil ma/ /shar du bh+ruṃ las dri chen/ lhor aṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du khaṃ las dri chu/ dbus su na las ma'i sha /byang shar du gaṃ las ba glang gi sha /sha lhor nāṃ las glang po che'i sha/ lho nub tu haṃ las rta'i sha /nub byang du ṣaṃ las ce spyang gi sha rnams kyis gang ba/ steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sna bug nas thon/ rlung gi ba dan la phog /yaṃ las rlung g.yos/ raṃ las me sbar/ thod pa'i rdzas rnams bskol/ zhu zhing gyen du lud pa'i mi gtsang ba rnams phyir phyung*/ steng gi āḥzla ba'i dkyil 'khor hūṃ rdo rje gyur pa oṃ dang bcas te thod par lhung bas rdzas rnams lan bdun du dkrugs shing sbyangs/ yang rdo rje 'greng bur gnas pa'i lte bar āḥlas byung ba'i zla ba las hūṃ dang rtse mor la oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/
sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ oṃ āḥhūṃ

lan gsum dang*/ ha ho hrīḥ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ 'bring du byed na lag pa thal mo kha sbyar ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bsam/ oṃ zhes brjod lag pa g.yon pa bsten pas oṃ las 'od 'phros bdud rtsi snod bcud dang bcas pa la phog stong par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan pas āḥzhes pas āḥ'i 'od zer gyis rin po che'i thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum tsam du bsam pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas phyur gyis gang bar bsam/ lag pa gnyis ka bstan pas hūṃ gis 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa'i kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ shin tu bsdu bar byed na/ thod pa bcud dang bcas pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum brjod pa la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag tu med par gyur bar bsam mo/ / lha thams cad kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs shing gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas yang sngar bzhin/ ar+ghṃ la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lha mo'i 'khor gyis bcom ldan bskor/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu khyod kyi thugs/ /sems can kun gyi don mdzad rnams/ /bcom ldan mchog tu dgyes rdo rje/ /zhal mdzes thugs kyi dgongs pa 'grub/ / thugs dgyes mdzod cig dgyes rdo rje/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ hūṃ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thams cad dngos po rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad rang bzhin gnas/

thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kyai rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal/ / mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni/ /bskal ba'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar/ /ral pa'i cod pan dbu'i rgyan du bcings/ /mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /sku la gzi brjid phyag stong ldan pa po/ /dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung bsnams shing*/ /rab 'jigs stag gi lpags pa sku la gsol/ /sku chen du kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud dang mu stegs lha min bcom/ /gshin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thams cad snyoms par zhugs te gcig tu 'dus pa byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le dkar po dwangs shing 'od zer 'phro ba ltar mi bzod pa zhig tu gyur nas bde chen 'khor lo'i lte ba la gnas par bsam/ de'i 'od zer gyis spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang lus kyi nang dang snang ba thams ba cad khyab pas thams cad kyang 'od dkar po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ slar 'dus te thig le la thim/ de ltar sems dang thig le dbyer med pa de la ma bcos pa'i tshul gyi mnyam par bzhag /de bzhin du mgrin pa'i lha tshogs rnams zhu bas thig le dmar po dang*/ snying kha'i lha rnams zhu bas thig le sngon po/ lte ba'i lha rnams zhu bas thig le ser po dang*/ gsang gnas kyi lha tshogs rnams zhu bas thig le ljang khur gyur/ lhag ma'i dmigs pa spyi bo'i thig le bzhin bskyang*/ mthar lnga char las 'od zer 'phros/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs zhing yongs su dag par byas/ thams cad kyang rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de rnams kyang 'od zer gyis rnam par zhu/

rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor lha dang bcas pa yang 'od zer rnam pa lngar zhu ste bdag nyid la thim/ bdag nyid thig le bzhi dang bcas pa yang snying kha'i thig le la thim/ de nyid kyang 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag /slar yang de nyid kyi ngang las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyud sde lnga'i lus dkyil dang bcas pa skad cig tsam gyis grub par gyur/ de ltar bsgoms pas lo zla tsam gyis lam lnga'i rim pa lnga phyag rgya bzhi'i rtags rnams rdzogs par 'gyur zhes grub chen khyung pos gsungs so/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la sngags 'di rnams bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ aṣ+tā na nā ya/ piṃ gor+dha ke sha war+t+ma ne/ tsa turbiṃ sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ṭa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzi mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ne kan+dhā ri ṇe/ arah+ma ta kru ra tsit+ta ya/ ar+dhen+du daṃ ṣ+ti ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ ka rā ya ka rā ya/ gardzā ya gardzā ya/ tardzā ya tardzā ya/ sho ṣā ya sho ṣā ya/ sab+ta sā ga rā na ban dha ban dha/ nā ga aṣ+ta kān/ gṛ+-ih+ṇa gṛ+-ih+ṇa/ sha truṃ/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ ha haṃ/ phaṭa swāhā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri he badz+ra ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ aṃ swāhā/ oṃ maṃ swāhā/ oṃ aṃ swāhā/ oṃ aṃ swāhā/ oṃ ūṃ swāhā/ oṃ daṃ swāhā/ oṃ paṃ swāhā/ oṃ laṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra h+ya gri ba hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra su ka ra gṛ ba hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ku ku ra gṛ ba hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra sing ha gri ba hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de ni mtshon cha can gyi'o/ / oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rika hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥspar+sha badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrat+na dh+rika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro līka hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā dh+rika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmo hā ra ti hūṃ/

oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥru pa badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥshab+ta badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥgan+dha badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥr sa badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmeṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhrī hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+man+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan ta kṛ ta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.ār+ya a tsa la hūṃ/ oṃ āḥṭāk+ki rā ga dzā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥnī la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmahā bā la hūṃ/ oṃ āḥtsakra warti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsuṃ bha rā dzāḥhūṃ/ de ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'o/ / oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī āḥhri hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āḥ hri hūṃ/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī āḥhri hūṃ/ de ni mahā ma ya'i 'o/ / oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri he badz+ra ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥgaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥshaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥṭaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ de ni/ mtsho skyes lha dgu'i yin no/ / oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dza la saṃ bha ra swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hriḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai badz+ra war+ṇa nī yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ taṃ pu dza o a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gri sau su na si ma ku/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes bde mchog gi sngags phreng bsdus pa'o/

/ rgyas par ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ / oṃ ā dhi swāhā/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tiḥbi kri tā na nā hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā dzi na dzika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrat+na dh+rika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro lika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā dh+rika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmo ha rā ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrā ga rā ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmud ga ra dhṛka hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ dan+d+ra dh+rika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+ma dhṛka hūṃ/ oṃ āḥkharga dhṛka hūṃ/ oṃ āḥṇa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥyo hūṃ/ oṃ āḥni hūṃ/ oṃ āḥr hūṃ/ zhes pa ni rdo rje 'jigs byed lha tshogs kyi yin no/ /rgyas par na mtshon cha can la phreng ba'i sngags 'di dag bzla bar bya'o/ / oṃ hriḥswāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ye sid+dhi pa ra ma yo ge shwa ri ka pā la mā la dha ri ṇi ru dhi ra pra ye sh+ma shā na bā si nī hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ri shwa ri/ kha ṭ+wāṃd+gi/ mahā badz+ri ṇi ka pā la mā la/ mu ku ṭo ā' kaṭadha/ sarba duṣ+ta da ba mā kaṭ+ṭa/ ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ra dzi te pa ra ma gu h+ye ka pā la mā lā ni bhu te sarba duṣ+ta mo ha ni pri ye e h+ya hi bha ga wa ti badz+ra gu h+ye shwa rī/ ba hu bi dha be sha dha ri ṇi/ sarba duṣ+ta ni bā ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bertā li kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba duṣ+ta bi kṛ ta be ṣa dha ri ṇi/ bi kri ta laṅga ra bhu ṣe te ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa/ mā bi lam+ba/ mā bi lam+ba/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra pra be sha ya man+ṭa la ma dh+ye/ ur+thā pa ya sarba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e h+ye bha ga ba ti badz+ra gu h+ye shwa ri ba hu bi dha be sha dha ri ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga ta duṣ+te sa mā ya ma nu sma ra ha na ha na/ raṅga raṅga/ raṅga pā ya raṅga pā ya/ sū ra ya sū ra ya/ ā be sha ā be sha /sarba bhu ta narta narta/ nartā pa ya nartā pa ya/

haḥha ha ha ha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shū la a gri bhin+dha bhin+dha sarba duṣ+ta hri da yaṃ/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ nirma tha nirma tha/ mā ra ya mā rā ya/ ma bi lam+ba mā bi lam+ba/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma he shwa ri/ haṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ haḥ ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ bhak+ṣa la sarba duṣ+tan nirma tha hri da yaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sum+bha ni dip+ta sa ma ya badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ba ḍa bā mu khi yo ge shwa ri hīḥhi hi hi hi hūṃ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī mu khī tri baṃ ba hūṃ/ oṃ tsan+d+ra sūr+ya hu tā sha ni siṃ ha sha ni nirnā de siṃ ha bgatre ni ṭāṃ ṭāṃ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dha ru dzī ba ni mahā yak+ṣi ṇī shwa ni ru pi nī mahā prā la ya nirnā dā+e kā ma ru pi ṇī trāṃ tra ḍa ṭa hoḥ dgyes mdzad lha dgu'i gtso bo la yang aṣ+ta mang du bzla zhing khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa'i phreng ba'i sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'ang ci rigs par bzlas te zur du rtogs par bya'o/ / thun mtshams su gtor ba 'bul bar 'dod na/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig tsam gyis grub par gyur/ bzlas pa'i skabs su bstan pa ltar sngags re re'i mthar/ a kā ro sbyar ba'i gtso bo rnams la lan bdun bdun/ 'khor rnams la re re phul la/ gong du ye shes pa la mchod pa 'bul ba ltar*/ phy-i+i nang gsang bas mchod/ rang rang gi bstod pas kyang bdag bskyed ltar bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la bar 'dir gtor ma 'bul/ de nas spyi gtor ni/ slar yang gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol nam mkha' la chos 'byung sum brtsegs dbus ma'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sngon po/ steng ma'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dkar po/

'og ma'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dmar po/ dbus ma'i pad+ma'i lte ba la bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje/ de'i 'dab ma brgyad la shar du iṃ las dbang po dkar po glang po che la bzhugs pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhor yaṃ las gshin rje mthing nag ma he la bzhugs pa dbyug pa dang tho ba/ nub tu wāṃ las chu lha dmar skya chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags dang pad+ma/ byang du yaṃ las gnod sbyin ser po rta la bzhon pa shing thog dang ne'u le/ byang shar du bhaṃ las 'byung po dkar po spyan gsum pa glang la bzhon pa rtse gsum dang zhags pa/ shar lhor raṃ las me lha dmar po ra skyes la bzhugs pa bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs/ lho nub tu naṃ las srin po nag po ro langs la bzhon pa ral gri dang thod pa/ nub byang du bāṃ las rlung lha ljang gu ri dwags la bzhon pa ba dan dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin du ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ steng gi pad+ma'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du shaṃ las brgya byin dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu/ lhor oṃ las tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la bzhugs pa spyi blugs dang rtse gsum/ nub tu biṃ las khyab 'jug dmar ser 'khor lo dang dung*/ byang du truṃ las dbang phyug mthing ga rtse gsum dang thod pa/ byang shar du kaṃ las gzhon nu smin drug dkar po mda' gzhu/ shar lhor gaṃ las tshogs bdag dkar po la phug dang la du'i snod 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu bh+riṃ las bh+riṃ gi ri ti dmar po mdung dang mda'/ nub byang du kaṃ las legs ldan nag po ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ 'khor 'dod khams kyi lhas bskor ba/ 'og gi 'dab ma brgyad kyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du phaṃ las dga' po ser po/ lhor phiṃḥlas dung skyong dkar po/ nub tu phuṃ las mtha' yas sngon po/

byang du pheṃ las rigs ldan ljang khu/ byang shar du phoṃ las pad+ma chen po dkar po/ shar lhor phūṃ las 'jog po dmar po/ lho nub tu phīṃ las nor rgyas kyi bu khra bo/ nub byang du phaiṃ las pad+ma dkar po thams cad kyang pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sbrul mgo bdun dang ldan zhing stod lha'i dbu can smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas sbrul dang g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ 'khor ngan song gsum gyis bskor ba/ 'byungapo brgyad gsum nyi shu bzhi po thams cad rin po ches brgyan pa/ bu dang chung ma la sogs pa 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa'o/ / zhes bskyed la so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas gau rī'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa kha dog lnga 'phros nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa'i phyogs skyong lha klu 'khor dang bcas pa mdun du bkugs/ tsau ri pra be sha ya hūṃ gi dam tshig pa la zhugs/ bai tā li ban+dha baṃ gyis gnyis med du bstims/ ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ snyoms par zhugs pa ltar bde ba'i ro myang bas zhu ste/ dbus kyi phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams hūṃ sngon po'i thig ler gyur/ steng gi lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams oṃ dkar po'i thig ler gyur/ 'og gi klu chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams āḥdamar po'i thig ler gyur pa las/ bar ma'i hūṃ rnams las mi bskyod pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa sku mdog mthing ga yum dang bcas par gyur/ steng ma'i oṃ brgyad las rnam snang sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yum dang bcas par gyur/ 'og gi āḥbargyad las snang mtha' sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yum dang bcas par gyur/ thams cad dur khrod kyi rgyan can zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gau ṝ dzaḥzhes pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs ye shes pa bkug tsau ri hūṃ gis so sor gzhug

/bai tā li baṃ gyis gnyis med du bstims/ ghasma rī hoḥ yis dgyes par byas/ gong bzhin skye mched dang sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs nas dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ mchod dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil bas/ bar ma rnams la mi bskyod pa/ steng ma rnams la rnam snang*/ 'og ma rnams la snang mtha' chags bral gyi cha lugs can rnams kyis dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ / bsdus par byed na/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong bcu la srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gtor mgron rnams la phog pas skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i su 'gyur/ ces so/ / oṃ in da/ dza ma dza la/ dzak+kha bhu ta/ ba hi na bā u/ rak+kha tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā ta baspa tā la patā la/ ar+tha palpa swā hā/ e daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza dzi gha/ phul+la dhu pa maṃ sa/ siṃ gha/ aṃ ba/ saspa/ kadz+dza/ mā da khan+ṭi khu ṇi phe ṭa ga ta/ oṃ ā ka ro sogs lan gsum gyis 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog / sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro= /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /mi rtog nam mkha' dri ma med/ /dngos 'dzin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro= /rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro= /rdo rje dag pa gdod mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro= /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/

/sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong la/ / bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i gtor ma dang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang*/ /mtha' yas sems can ma lus la/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /yon tan 'phrin las rgyas par shog / kaul+la e ri ṭa ṭhi a bol+la mum+mu ṇi ri kak+ko la sogs rdo rje'i glu dbyangs yang blangs/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs sho lo gsum gyis bkra shis brjod/ skye shing skye bar rigs mchog tu/ /skye shing khengs med dam tshig ldan/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje ston pa dang*/ /brtse ldan bla mar gus 'gyur shog /skye shing skye ba thams cad du/ / lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*/ /btsun mo'i khu ba len par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi/ /lam de myur du 'grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma sgrol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog / ces smon lam btab yi ge brgya pas nyam chags bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /lhag pa dang ni chad pa sogs dang*/ bag med spyod pa ma dag pas/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga ni/ /ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ / ces bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs/ mdzad du gsol/ ces bsnyan mnan/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bdag nyid la thim/ oṃ muḥ gats+tsha gats+tsha swā bha wa naṃ/ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor yang skad cig gis mi snang bar 'gyur te/ 'od gsal gyi ngo bo'o/ / de'i ngang las tha mal gyi shes pa yun ring du bskyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis par gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ snang ba thams cad kyang lha'i 'khor lor gyur/ slar yang smon lam btab te thun mtshams la 'jug go / kha zas bza' ba'i tshe gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ phud bla ma yi dam myur mdzad ye shes mgon po rnams la gtor ma'i tshul du phul/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha la snying khar rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang*/ lte bar myur mdzad mgon po dang*/ phyogs skyong pa rnams dang mkha' 'gro sde lnga la sogs pa rnams/ steng 'og gi lha de dag thams cad kyang lto ba thab khung du gyur nas 'bar ba'i me dpung gi dbus na gnas par bsam/ de rnams mchod pa'i tshul du bza' bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang/ rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor te dus thams cad du yid gzhan du ma gyur bar de ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar dgyes mdzad gsal bar bkod/ /'ga' zhig lam 'dir mi mos shing*/ kha cig mos kyang gzhan dang 'dres/ /ma 'dres rgyas bsdus skyon bral ba/ /'god pa gang de'ang rmad du byung*/ /yang dgyes pa rdo rje mtsho skyes la sogs par dkyil 'khor gzhan lnga po'i sgrub thabs la brten nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa 'dod na'ang*/ lugs 'di nyid kyi de dang de'i sgrub pa 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du nyams su blangs la/ gsang 'dus la lha rnams mngal byin grub mtshams dang*/ gzhan rnams la ye shes pa bsre ba'i sngon du lus dkyil gong bzhin 'god par bya'o/ /gal te dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can 'ba' zhig bsgom par 'dod na lus dkyil rnams bor bas 'grub cing*/ yang phyi dkyil drug po gang yang rung ba yang skad cig gis bskyed pa lus dkyil 'god pa dang*/ lhan skyes la gtso bo phyag mang lnga 'god pa dang*/

lhan skyes la lhan skyes lnga 'god pa ste/ rgyas bsdus drug gi dbye bas rgyud sde lnga'i sgrub thabs nyer mkho sum cu drug tu 'gyur zhing*/ phyi dkyil rgyas pa la lus dkyil bsdus pa bkod pa sogs kyis phye na mtha' yas par 'gyur la/ dkyil 'khor so so'i nyams len la mngon rtog rgyas pa dang sa bon tsam las bskyed pa dang*/ skad cig gis bskyed pa dang gtso bo rkyang ba bsgoms pa dang*/ lhan skyes bsgom pas dbye bas sum cu tham par 'gyur zhing*/ me tog phog pa'i lha gang dang gang yin pa de/ 2sgrub par bya dgos pas dkyil 'khor drug pa lha brgya dang sum cu rtsa brgyad yod la/ de dag sgrub tshul na stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sa bon las bskyed la dbu rgyan rang chas su bsam/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ ye shes pa dang bsres nas sngags bzlas pas 'grub pa yin no/ / ༈ lwa ba pas mdzad gzhung bzhin te/ lus dkyil 'god pa man ngag yin/ /glegs bam klog pa'i phyugs de dag /gus dang bral ba skal ba'i skyon/ /rgyud sde lnga'i lus dkyil gcig tu sgom pa'i mngon rtogs ston zin pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ / 'di man chad du bshad par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga so so'i sgrub thabs dang*/ mtshon cha can gyi dkyil 'khor 'ga' zhig sgom par byed pa la'ang gong du bshad pa'i bdag bsrung ba yan chad byed par bla ma rnams bzhed par 'dug pas/ de ltar byas kyang skyon du 'gyur ba dka' mod/ gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bdun po 'di dag gi bsnyen pa sogs byed pa'i tshe/ de yan chad gegs bsrung ba'i don du yun ring bsgom par bzhed par mngon pas/ dkyil 'khor rkyang pa phyi ma 'di rnams la 'di yan chad ma bsgoms na mngon rtogs kyi yan lag chad par mi 'gro bar mngon la/ khyad par 'dus pa'am bde mchog la phur gdab pa lan gnyis sogs mi dgos par mngon no/ / ༈ da ni so so'i mngon rtogs bshad par bya ste/

bdag nyid gang la mos pa de grub pa'i don du'am/ de la rab tu rgyas pa dgyes mdzad rdo rje lha dgu'i bskyed rim 'ba' zhig bsgom na/ rang dgyes mdzad he ru kar gsal ba'i snying gar raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ/ rang gi mdun du bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i he ru ka bzhugs pa la/ snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par gyur/ dkar mo ri dwags zhes pa la sogs pa brjod/ bdag gis sdig pa sogs/ grol bar shog / zhes yan lag lnga pa'am/ yang na gang zhig 'khor ba thog ma med nas ngan pa'i rnam par rtog pa las skyes pa'i bdag gis sdig pa byas pa de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bshags shing slar yang mi bgyid do/ /gang gi sems can thams cad kyi dge ba kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /bdag dang gzhan don rab sgrub phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub mchog sems bskyed/ /e ma ho sems can kun mgron gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyod/ / tshogs kyi zhing rang la thim/ tshad med bzhi bsgom / oṃ shū n+ya ta= stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ dbus sngo ba de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba gur ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa= sogs/ de las me lce khro bo dang bcas pa mched de phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bsregs shing tshar gcod par gyur/ de'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du laṃ las dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ljang gu/ de'i 'og tu baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po/

de'i 'og tu raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ de'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po/ bdag nyid 'od gsal las langs nas bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i nga rgyal du gnas par byas la/ 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor yang rang gi sems kyi ngo bo'o/ /'byung ba bzhi gcig tu 'dres pa las/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta bab bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang*/ kha khyer dang*/ pha gu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ pu shū la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa do shal dang*/ do shal phyed pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba ste/ shing dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ dngos grub 'grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams brgyad dang bcas shing*/ ro dang ro langs dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang*/ mchod rdzas thams cad dang*/ rus pa'i tshogs kyis gang ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po ches brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi lha snam/ shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan shar sgor tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po kham ser/ nub tu nye dbang ljang khu/ byang du drag po thal dkar gan rkyal du bkram pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du tshangs pa/ lho ru brgya byin/ nub tu nye dbang*/ byang du drag po/ byang shar gyi grwar gshin rje nag po/ shar lhor gnod sbyin ser po/ lho nub tu srin po smugs nag /nub byang du thags bzang ris ljang khu/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ dkar po rnams yongs su gyur ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/
