de'i steng du ka kha gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa dmar po rnams yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃ las thod pa sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ aṃ las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug /de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las dpal he ru ka / 'og nas 'byung ba ltar rgyas pa'am/ bsdus na/ sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal nas hūṃ spro ba/ lha dang lha min thams cad sdigs par mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ yum gyi mkha' hrīḥ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad ze 'bru la as mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su kha= sogs/ ṣa me/ zhes yab kyi zhal nas gsungs par gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje nag po/ bh+rūṃ ser po las byung ba'i nor bu'i bu gar phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā sogs/ ṣa me/ zhes yum gyis gsung bar 'gyur/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba chen pos dgyes pa/ bsrubs pa dang srub pa'i sbyor bas zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems la sangs rgyas rnams thim/ yum gyi mkha' nang du byang chub kyi sems su gyur/ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ gaṃ /paṃ shaṃ laṃ ṭaṃ/ sa bon brgyad du gyur/ phyogs mtshams kyi gdan rnams kyi steng du yang nyi zla kha sbyor re re gnas pa/ mkha' nang gi sa bon brgyad spros te/ de rnams kyi bar du phyin pas sa bon rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gri gugacang te'u/ rus sbal/ sbrul/ seṅge/ dge slong*/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ so sor nyi zla phyag mtshan ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ shar du gau ri sogs nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i bde ba chen po ldan pa la bar do'i rnam shes rjes su chags pas/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur/ de nas puk+ka si la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhis gdung ba'i dbyangs kyi bzhengs par bskul ba ni/

rje btsun snying rje nas/ ma mdzad cig /ces bskul bas bcom ldan 'das rab tu sad de thig le gong bzhin du ā li las zla ba bskyed/ de'i steng du sngar bzhin kā li las nyi ma bskyed de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃ dang aṃ las thod pa dang gri gug hūṃ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog zhes pa nas/ 'jigs par mdzad pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ drag po chen po rtsa ba'i zhal nag po nas/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum thams cad khyab/ snod gzhal yas khang bcud he ru kar gyur/ mkha' la spyod pa rnams oṃ la thim/ sa 'og nas spyod pa āḥl thim/ sa steng nas spyod pa rnams snying khar thim/ yang hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' lha dgu oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ ar+ghṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo la sogs pa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ rnga'i sgra byung*/ gur gum dang me tog gi char phab/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ thabs dang shes rab dang*/ rgod pa dang*/ blta ba dang*/ 'khyud pa dang*/ gnyis gnyis las/ bum pa dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab dang*/ bde ba chen po'i dbang rnams thob/ gtso bo yab yum dang*/ gau ri

sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ khams gsum po thams cad dkyil 'khor du gyur pa bdag nyid la thim shing*/ lha mo brgyad yang zhal brgyad la thim/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi po rnams la spyi bor haṃ mgrin par oṃ/ snying gar hūṃ/ lte bar aṃ/ gtum mo yongs su 'bar te de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rgyud la 'gro 'ong byas/ haṃ yig la thim/ de las thig le yongs su 'dzag pa aṃ la thim/ 'khor lo'i gzugs kyi mi bskyod pa/ /hūṃ/ rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /dz+riṃ/ mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /aṃ/ lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ khaṃ/ yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin 'god/ /hūṃ/ sa bon de rnams las byung ba'i/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga thal chen rnams/ rgyal ba rigs drug gi bdag nyid du gyur/ rgyas par spo na/ rigs lnga dang rdor sems he ru ka phyag gnyis par bskyed la/ de zhu ba'i phyag rgyar bsam zhing*/ oṃ dha ra dha ra sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs par bya'o/ / mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma sogs/ bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang gri thod 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can no/ /de tsam sgom par mi nus na/ sa bon 'ba' zhig bsgom pas kyang chog go /de la lha phyi ma gnyis lte ba dang gsang bar 'god par bzhed do/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ oṃ aṣ+ta sogs nas/ haṃ ha phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri he badz+ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha swāhā/ zhes pa rnams bzlas bya'i sngags so/ /de nas mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i dmigs pa bsgoms pas 'od gsal du bsdu bar bya ste/ rang gi snying gar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du hūṃ/ bdag med ma'i snying gar zla ba la aṃ/ khams gsum thams cad 'od du zhu nas thabs kyi cha rnams rang dang*/ shes rab kyi cha rnams yum la thim/ yum zla ba aṃ dang bcas pa bdag nyid la thim/ bdag nyid nyi zla la thim/

hūṃ gis 'od zer gyi tshogs ā li kā li dang bcas pas khams gsum gyi dngos po thams cad 'od zer gyi rang bzhin du byas/ thams cad kyang hūṃ la thim/ zla ba dang nyi ma yang hūṃ la zhugs/ de nyid kyang nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ 'dir ni thog ma mtha' dbus med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ / ces mnyam par bzhag la/ khams gsum po mtha' dag sgyu ma'o/ /rmi lam lta bur shes par byas nas bar chad bsrung ba'i don du sngar bzhin go cha bcu gnyis la bkod nas thun mtshams la 'jug pa yin no/ /he ru ka gzhan gsum la gtso bo'i zhal phyag 'gyur ba dang*/ sngags kyi khyad par ma gtogs 'di kho na bzhin yin la/ 'khor gyi sngags sgrub thabs su ma bshad kyang bzla bar 'dod na/ oṃ a āḥsogs/ aṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang 'grub pa'i slob dpon chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du byas pa ste/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i bzhed pa'i lugs ltar bkod pa/ dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i sgrub thabs tshig zor yang ba la dga' ba rnams la phan pa'o/ / 'dir smras pa/ byin rlabs che na nyung ba'ang mchog /byin rlabs chung na mang bas ci/ /gzhung don 'khyog po'i bshad pa yis/ /ha cang thal bar ma byed cig / dgyes mdzad lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te gnyis pa'o/ / ༈ 'khor lo sdom pa kho na'i bskyed rim rgyas pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs gyur cig /gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad do/ / tshor ba'i phung po ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam shes kyi phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid gyur pa ni dpal rdo rje he ru ka'o/

/mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje'o/ kha la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni ltung bar byed pa ma'o/ / chu'i khams la ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma drwa ba can ma ste/ tsham rngam dang bcas pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod do/ / sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba gur bla bre mda'i drwa ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ g.yon phur bu dang g.yas tho ba thogs pa spros/ yang sprul rnams kyi phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug ste/ rwa ba'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du hūṃ las byung ba'i grub khung rnams su bcug /phur bus spyi bor btab/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+tan hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī lā ya sarba pa paṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra ki la badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarbā bigh+nan kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces tho bas brdung bas bgegs rnams tshar bcad/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ga ra badz+ra kī la a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūṃ sngo skya 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba/ de'i 'od kyis bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du gsal bar byas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs sho lo ka gcig brjod/ swa bhā wa sogs/ shū n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da'i rnam pas nam mkhar bzhag

/'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab rnams steng nas steng du brtsigs pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte bar paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de nyid kyi lte ba la a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ rnams yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa rnams yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du nam mkha'i nā da yongs su gyur pa zhugs/ nā da las thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las ha/ de las zhabs kyu te hūṃ yig dkar po'o/ /de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dkyil 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus su bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ /de'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma'i mu 'khyud can/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ gsum ga'ang rtsibs brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus su bde chen 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng ba can/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ bdag nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa sogs/ 'on kyang phyag g.yas pa ni gri gug bsnams pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin no/ / de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par gyur/

yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje aṃ las byung ba'i nor bu byāṃ gy-i mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po oṃ las ze'u 'bru trāṃ gyi mtshan pa/ lte bar sarba bud+dha'i sngags/ snying gar bai ro tsa na'i sngags/ mgrin par yi ge bdun pa/ dpral bar yi ge nyer gnyis pa/ yum gyi dpral bar bai rā+o tsa nā/ mgrin par sarba bud+dha/ snying gar yi ge bdun pa/ yab yum snyom par zhugs/ yi ge rnams kyang phan tshun rjes su chags pas sbyor ba la/ gnas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni la ma'o/ / chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o/ /sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa ni rab tu gtum ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gti pa'i mig can ma'o/ /spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'o/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen ma'o/ /dad pa'i dbang po ni dpa' bo'i blo gros ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi'u thung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni laṅga'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni sa srung ma'o/ / dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni shugs can ma'o/ /dran pa'i stobs ni su ra bhak+ṣi'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni sngo bsangs lha mo'o/ /shes rab kyi stobs ni rab tu bzang po'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag par byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta'i sna ba ma'o/ /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni bya gdong ma'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni ro hī'o/ /chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni shau n+ṭi nī'o/

/dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rab tu dpa' mo'o/ / yang dag pa'i lta ba ni stobs chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'khor lo'i bsgyur ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang de rnams nyid kyi rnam par dag pa can no/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni kha gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams bsrung ba ni gshin rje pho nya mo'o/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa ni gshin rje mche ba ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa spong ba ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /spyi bo pul+lir ma la yar khan+ṭa ka pa la dang rab tu gtum mo/ /spyi gtsug dza lan+dha rar ma ha kaṃ ka la/ sogs gong bzhin la/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen po ste nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhoḥsarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ snying gar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi sogs/ rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po rdo rje phag mo sogs/ tsaṇ+ḍa ka'i ngo bo/ pheṃ/ zhes ye shes 'khor lo'i dbang gi lha dang lhan cig spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang*/ ye she pa dbyer med du gyur/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha= sogs/ dbang gi lha mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams te dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar sogs/ shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsungs zhing dbang bskur bas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo dang thugs 'khor ba rnams la mi bskyod pa/

gsung 'khor ba rnams la 'od dpag med/ yum dang sku 'khor ba rnams la rnam snang*/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma rnams la rin 'byung*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la don grub kyis dbu rgyan par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs te/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la myang*/ lha thams cad thabs shes snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde bas mnyes par bsam/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste / oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ka sogs/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ hriḥha ha sogs nye ba'i snying po'o/ / oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī sogs/ yum gyi nye snying ngo*/ /oṃ badz+ra be ro tsa na sogs snying po'o/ /'phreng ba'i sngags rnams ni logs su shes par bya'o/ / oṃ oṃ ha/ oṃ na ma hi sogs/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa ni go cha'i sngags so/ /skabs 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa rnal 'byor chen mo yang bsgom par bya'o/ / thun mtshams la 'jug par 'dod na/ dkyil 'khor thams cad skad cig tsam gyis bdag nyid la thim/ sngar bzhin go cha gnyis bkod/ so dang sen mo la ni thod pa'i dum bu'o/ /skra dang ba spu la ni keng rus chen po ma'o sogs nas/ snabs la ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /dpa' bo rtsa ba'i sngags sogs dang*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa la sogs btags/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /lus kyi khams ni btags pa po/ /dpa' bo'i go cha drug gi ni/ /phyag rgya yis ni lus mdzes pa'o/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin/ /mgrin pa mgur chas mdzes pa nyid/ /lha yi snying po sngags kyi ni/ /'phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyis mdzes/ /yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /gdub skor gyis ni rna bar mdzes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro yis/ /lpags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyis/ /ska rags byas pa rnam par brgyan/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i/

/sngags ni 'thung ba'i thod pa yin/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi sngags gang yin/ /thod po'i dbu la brgyan pa po/ / tsham rngam dang bcas sum+bha ni lan gnyis kyis phyogs srungs/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha'i sku/ sgrar grags pa thams cad gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad thugs kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor brjod/ /mya ngan las 'byung dpa' bo ni/ /drug pa sems kyi sprul pa ste/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa'o/ /shes rab gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ / zhes brjod nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug ste/ gtor ma la sogs pa las kyi bya ba rnams ci bde bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang slob dpon chen po lū yi pa'i gzhung ji lta ba'i rjes su 'brang zhing grub pa'i slob dpon chen po khyung po rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa'i phyag srol gyi nyams bzhes ltar bkod pa'o/ /

'dir smras pa/ deng sang sgrub thabs mang po dag /dpe ni sna tshogs kun btus nas/ /man ngag byin rlabs rgyun bral yang*/ /yig tshogs che ba ngom par byed/ /bde mchog lū yi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te gsum pa'o/ / 'dus pa'i rgyud la brten nas bskyed rim sgom par 'dod na/ rang skad cig gis zhe sdang rdo rje mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po de las hūṃ bcu de spros te/ phyogs bcur nyi ma'i gdan la 'khod pa yongs su gyur pa ni/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po/ nub tu rta mgrin dmar po/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can/ byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes te/ de rnams nag po thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs/ hūṃ/ zhes bka' bsgo bas gnod mdzes dpag tu med pa byung nas phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams thams cad yan la zhags pas bsdams/ lcags kyus snying gar btab/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wak+tsit+ta badz+ra ṇaṃ oṃ ḍak+ki hūṃ dzaḥzhes bkug ste/ brub khung gru gsum rnams su bcug /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba las rang 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bcu/ lte ba man chad phur pa'i rnam pa can byung ste/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor btsug /gnod mdzes rnams phyag tu tho ba thogs par gyur te/ phur bus spyi bo nas brdungs pas/ bgegs rnams bsgral te rnam par shes pa dbyings su spar bar gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta sogs/ hūṃ phaṭa/ sprul pa rnams gnod mdzes la thim/ khro bo dang phur bu las me lce phyogs kun tu spros nas/ bgegs rnams kyi lhag ma thams cad tshig cing gdug pa can rnams me ri'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de'i nang du 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

'khor yug thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur du gyur te bgegs dang bral bar gyur/ dngos po med la sgom pa med sogs/ med pa'o/ / stong pa la cung zad mnyam par bzhag / stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi dbus su hūṃ yaṃ hūṃ las rlung gis dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du hūṃ raṃ hūṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du hūṃ baṃ hūṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du hūṃ laṃ hūṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ thams cad kyang rdo rje gnyis gnyis gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du rdo rje'i lte bar gh+ruṃ yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus en+d+ra nī la'i stegs bu'i steng du/ rdo rje'i ra ba zlum po 'od zer sna lnga 'bar ba/ nang ling tshe dgur gyur pa dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ khro bo bcu la nyi ma/ shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma kī la rdo rje/ gzhan lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po byang phyogs pa rnams la rdo rje rgya gram gyi gdan/ dbus su rdo rje 'chang sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu= 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khyud rgyas yum reg bya rdo rje ma/ rang dang 'dra ba/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ ling tshe rnams la shar du rnam snang*/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa/

shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma kī/ nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma/ rim pa gsum pa'i snam bu la/ shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon du byams pa dang sa snying*/ lho sgo'i g.yas g.yon du phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po/ nub sgo g.yas g.yon du 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dpal/ byang sgo g.yas g.yon du sgrib pa rnam sel dang kun tu bzang po/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed/ lho sgor gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ nub sgor rta mgrin/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can byang shar du 'chol ba/ steng gi ya phug gi nang du gtsug tor/ 'og tu sa gzhi'i nang du gnod mdzes/ lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad bkugs te dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas bcug /byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thob nas rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od kyi rnam snang*/ spyan ma/ sa snying*/ gzugs rdo rje ma/ byams pa/ gshin rje gshed/ mi g.yo ba rnams bdag la thim zhing 'od gsal gyi ngang du yal/ rin 'byung*/ mā ma kī/ phyag rdor/ sgra rdo rje ma gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ 'dod rgyal rnams 'od gsal du thim/ 'od dpag med gos dkar mo/ nam snying*/ dri rdo rje ma/ rta mgrin dbyug sngon can rnams 'od gsal du thim/ don grub/ sgrol ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug /ro rdo rje ma/ sgrib sel/ kun bzang*/ bgegs mthar byed/ stobs po che rnams 'od gsal du thim/ gtsug tor gnod mdzes/ reg rdo rje ma rnams 'jam dpal la thim/ de dag gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo yang thams cad stong pa 'od gsal la thim/

de yan chad sngon 'gro yin no/ / oṃ shū n+ya ta sa de bzhin nyid la yun ring du dmigs/ sngar gyi/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi nam mkhar/ nyi ma dang zla ba dang pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad oṃ āḥhūṃ steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ 'bru gsum pad+ma nyi ma rnams rim pas zla ba la thim/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad zla ba la thim pas byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ dharmā dhar du swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zla ba'i dbus su/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ thim pa las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zla ba dang rdo rje 'dres pa las/ dang po'i mgon po dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i zag pa med pa'i bde ba la bkod/ mi bskyod pa la thim/ de nyid dbus kyi gdan la 'dug pa la/ bdag nyid kyang thim pas rang rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa dpa' bo gcig par gyur/ lus gzhal yas khang gi ngo bo la/ spyi bor gzugs phung oṃ las rnam snang*/ mgrin par 'du shes āḥlas snang mtha'/ snying gar rnam shes hūṃ las mi bskyod pa/ lte bar tshor phung swā las rin 'byung*/ brla'i rtsa bar 'du byed hā las don 'grub/ mig las sa snying*/ oṃ yig bzhi las rna ba phyag rdor/ sna nam snying*/ lce 'jig rten dbang phyug /rdo rje'i sgor/ lus sgrib sel/ tshigs pa las kun bzang*/ snying gar yid hūṃ las 'jam dpal/ hūṃ bcu las lag pa g.yas pa gshin rje gshed/ lag pa g.yon pa shes rab mthar byed/ kha la rta mgrin/ rdo rje la bgegs mthar byed/ dpung pa g.yas la mi g.yo ba/ g.yon la ḍak+ki/ pus mo g.yas/ ser po be con sngon po/ /g.yon la stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rnams 'khod par gyur pa/

rang gi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po las 'od zer sna lnga lha mo spyan ma dang bcas nam mkha' gang ba spros/ sangs rgyas rnams rnam snang du gyur pa snyoms 'jug gi bde bas mnyes par byas/ spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pa/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje'i sku ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed= / deng bdag byin gyi rlabs= /rdo rje'i sku ni mdzad du gsol/ /lha thams cad rjes chags kyis snyoms par zhugs/ 'od zer dkar po gyur spyi bo nas thim pas sku'i dbang phyug thob par gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin/ /phung po lnga yi rab tu rgyas/ /sangs rgyas sku yi rang bzhin gyi/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi lce'i steng du pad+ma la āḥ dmar po las 'od zer sna lnga gos dkar mo dang bcas nam mkha' gang ba spros/ sangs rgyas rnams 'od dpag med du gyur par snyoms 'jug gi/ sogs gong bzhin/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas gsung 'chang ba/ /chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed= gsung gi rdo rje mdzad= /phyogs bcur bzhugs la sogs/ gsol/ lha thams cad rjes chags kyi snyoms par zhugs/ 'od zer dmar po gyur te mgrin pa nas thim pas gsung gi /dbang phyug thob par gyur/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin/ /gsung de nges tshig phun sum tshogs/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi rang bzhin gyi bdag gi tshig kyang de 'drar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā/ waka= rang gi snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po las 'od zer sna lnga mā ma kī dang bcas nam mkha' gang ba spros/ sangs rgyas rnams mi bskyod par gyur pa snyoms 'jug sogs/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum= /deng bdag /thugs kyi rdo rje =

phyogs bcu sogs/ 'od zer nag por gyur te snying ga nas thim pas thugs kyi dbang phyug= /gsang ba'i bdag po blo ldan pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu ni/ / bdag gi sems kyang de 'dra gyur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā= tsit+ta= bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā= kā ya wāka tsit+ta= rang dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje 'chang yum dang bcas pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ nag po 'od zer 'bar ba/ spyi bor rigs bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems kyis bdag nyid tshim par byed par 'gyur/ rang gi bar du sme sha can gyi rigs las byung ba'i bu mo sngo bsangs mig yangs ma gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan pa/ de reg bya rdo rje ma gtso bo dang 'dra bar gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ byin pa gnyis la hā/ rim pa bzhin du dkar dmar sngo ser ljang ba rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ lte bar sa khams laṃ las spyan ma/ snying khar chu khams maṃ las mā ma kī/ mgrin par me khams paṃ las gos dkar mo/ spyi bor rlung khams taṃ las sgrol ma mig tu gzugs dzaḥ las gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar sgra hūṃ las sgra rdo rje ma/ snar dri baṃ las dri rdo rje ma/ lcer ro hoḥ las ro rdo rje ma/ pad+ma'i sna rtser reg bya khaṃ las reg bya rdo rje ma/ hūṃ bcu las lag pa g.yas pa ro langs rdo rje ma/ g.yon la gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ kha la khro gnyer ma/ bha gar ral pa gcig ma/ dpung pa g.yas la de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum sna tshogs rdo rje ma/ g.yon sna tshogs rin chen ma/ pus mo g.yas la sna tshogs pad+ma/ g.yon pa sna tshogs las ma/ rkang mthil gnyis su sa 'dzin lha mo/ rdo rje ro langs ma la sogs pa bcu po de dag ni khro bo bcu dang 'dra'o/

/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa rtse mo oṃ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa/ mkha' gsang gi nang 'od zer sna lngas khyab par gyur/ bdag rin chen 'byung ldan gyi nga rgyal du 'phos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga= sogs/ zhes 'khyud de rang nyid rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ snyoms par zhugs mchog tu dga' ba thob/ phaṭa rang nyid don 'grub tu gyur/ byang chub kyi sems phyung ba las byung ba'i lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spros te/ 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dzaḥbadz+ra sogs lus dkyil kyi 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba dang 'dres/ mkha' nang du 'dus pa'ithig le cha sum cu rtsa gnyis su gyur/ dbus kyi thig le mi bskyod pa sngon po/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ badz+ra dhṛka thugs kar drangs te phyir phyung*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul dang mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ ye shes pa rnams 'dres/ gcig tu 'dus par rang gi snying gar thim pas/ bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje mthing nag rtsa zhal khros pa/ g.yas zhi ba g.yon chags pa'i nyams can du gyur/ shar gyi thig le rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum sogs gong bzhin/ ral gri 'dzin/ dzi na dzika thugs kar drangs te phyir phyung*/

chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs= gti mug sbyangs/ rnam snang gi go 'phang la bkod/ sprul ba rnams dang 'dres/ gcig tu 'dus pa shar gyi le tsher 'khod/ de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur te/ lho'i thig le rin 'byung ser po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can ser nag dkar ba'i= rat+na dh+rika thugs kar= ser sna sbyangs/ rin 'byung gi= lho'i le tsher 'khod/ nub kyi thig le 'od dpag med dmar pau mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i= a ro lika thugs kar= 'dod chags= 'od dpag med kyi= nub kyi la= byang gi thig le don grub ljang gu mi bskyod pa'i= ljang nag dkar ba'i= pradz+nyā dh+rika thugs kar= phrag dog= don grub kyi go 'phang = byang gi le tsher 'khod/ 'di man chad spyi'i mdzad pa'i tshig rnams bor la/ shar lho'i thig le spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ mo ha ra ti thugs kar drangs te phyir phyung*/ gdon dang nad dang gdung ba thams cad zhi bar byas/ spyan ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams dang 'dres/ gcig tu 'dus pa shar lho'i grwar 'khod/ lho nub kyi thig le mā ma kī sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i= sngo dkar dmar= dī ṣa rā ti thugs kar= bgegs bsrung ba dang rgyas par mdzad/ mā ma kī'o= lho nub kyi grwar= byang shar gyi thig le gos dkar mo dmar mo/ 'od dpag tu med kyi dbu= dmar nag dkar ba'i= rā ga ra ti thugs kar= nad kyi nyen pa rnams bsrung bar byas/ gos dkar mo'i= nub byang gi grwar= byang shar gyi thig le sgrol ma ljang gu don grub kyi= ljang nag dkar ba'i= badz+ra rā ti thugs kar= de thams cad dbang du bsdus= sgrol ma'i= byang shar gyi grar= de'i phyi rol shar lho'i thig le gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo rnam snang gi dbu brgyan can/

dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis me long dmar po 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ut+pa dkar po/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ thugs kar= gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs/ gzugs bde bas mchod/ gzugs rdo rje ma'i go 'phang = rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lho'i grar= lho nub kyi thig le sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo mi skyod pa'i= sngo dkar dmar ba'i= sgra'i skye mched= sgra bde bas= sgra rdo rje ma'i= bden bral gyi grwar= nub byang gi thig le dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi= dmar nag dkar ba'i= dri'i skye mched= dri bde bas= dri rdo rje ma'i= nub byang gi grwar= byang shar gyi thig le ro rdo rje ma ljang gu don grub kyi= ljang nag dkar ba'i= ro'i skye mched= ro bde ba'i= ro rdo rje ma'i= byang shar gyi grar= dbus kyi thig le cha gcig reg rdo rje ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i= sngo dkar dmar ba'i

nas ral gri 'dzin pa zhes pa'i bar gtso bo bzhin/ reg bya'i skye mched/ reg bya'i bde ba'i= reg bya rdo rje ma'i= yum la thim/ snga ma'i phyi rol rim pa gsum pa'i lha snam gyi shar sgo'i g.yas su shar gyi thig le cha gcig /meṃ las byams pa rnam snang dang 'dra ba las/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ g.yas kyi dang po klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ rtsa rgyus dang nyon yid sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rtsa dang zag med kyi mngon shes la bkod/ shar sgo'i g.yon gyi lha snam la shar gyi thig le cha gcig las sa'i snying po rnam snang dang 'dra ba rnam snang gi dbu= mig dang mig shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i mig dang mig gi mngon shes la bkod/ lho sgo'i g.yas su lho'i thig le cha gcig oṃ las phyag rdor rin 'byung lta bu rin 'byung gi= rna ba dang rna ba'i shes pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rna ba dang rna ba'i mngon shes= /lho sgo'i g.yon du thig le cha gcig oṃ las nam mkha'i snying po rin 'byung lta bu rin 'byung gi dbu brgyan/ sna'i rnam shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i sna dang sna'i mngon shes= nub sgo'i g.yas su nub kyi thig le cha gcig oṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od dpag med dang mtshungs pa 'od dpag med kyi= lce dang lce'i rnam shes sbyangs/ rdo rje lce dang lce'i mngon shes= nub sgo'i g.yon du thig le'i cha gcig hūṃ las 'jam dpal 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba 'od dpag med kyi= yid kyi skye mched dang yid shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i yid dang gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes la bkod/ byang sgo'i g.yas su byang gi thig le cha gcig oṃ las sgrib pa rnam sel don yod grub pa lta bu don grub kyi= lus dbang rnam shes dang bcas pa/ rdo rje'i lus dang rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes= byang sgo'i g.yon du thig le cha gcig saṃ las kun tu bzangapo don grub lta bu don 'grub kyi=

tshigs rnams dang kun gzhi sbyangs/ rdo rje'i tshigs dang sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa la bkod/ lha yab thams cad ral pa'i thor tshugs sogs/ rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi shar gyi thig le gshin rje mthar byed nag po rnam snang gi= nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum= dgra sta 'dzin pa= ya man+ta kṛt+ta thugs kar= dbang po la sogs pa bgegs rnams tshar bcad= shar sgor= lho'i thig le shes rab mthar byed dkar po rin 'byung gi= dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal= pradz+nyān+ta kṛt+ta/ gshin rje dang me'i gdon rnams/ lho sgor= nub kyi thig le rta mgrin dmar po 'od dpag med kyi= dmar nag dkar ba'i= pad+man+ta kṛt+ta= klu'i gdon rnams= nub sgor= byang gi thig le bgegs mthar byed ljang khu don grub kyi= ljang nag dkar ba'i= bīgh+nan+ta krita= gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams= byang sgor= shar lho'i thig le mi g.yo ba nag po rnam snang gi= nag dkar dmar ba'i= a tsa la= rim gtong ba'i me lha'i gdon= shar lho'i grar= lho nub kyi thig le 'dod rgyal sngon po rin 'byung gi= sngo dkar dmar ba'i= tak+ki rā dza= srin po'i gdon= bden bral gyi grar= nub byang gi thig le dbyug sngan can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi= sngo dkar dmar ba'i= nī la dan+ṭa= rlung lha'i gdon rnams= nub byang gi grar= byang shar gyi thig le stobs po che sngon po don grub kyi dbu brgyan= nag dkar dmar ba'i= mahā ba la= mkha' 'gro ma dang dbang ldan gyi gdon= byang shar gyi grar= steng gi thig le gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i= sngo dkar dmar ba'i= uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti= tshangs pa dang gza' skar gyi gdon= steng gi grwar= 'og gi thig le gnod mdzes nag po mi bskyod pa'i= nag dkar dmar ba'i = bhud+dha rā dza= ku la ku ṭa la sogs pa'i dug brtan pa dang g.yo ba thams cad= 'og gi phyogs su 'khod par gyur/ khro bo thams cad kyang stobs chen pha rol gnon pa sogs/

tshar gcod pa'o zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ yang khro bo drug la hūṃ kho na 'byin sngags su mdzad pa yang yod do/ / rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la sogs/ deng bdag stsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi sogs/ sbyin par bya/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa abhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bar gyur/ de nas bar 'di phra thig gi rnal 'byor bsgom/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya/ bzlas pa'i man ngag gsal btab/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rika hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ngag bzlas ci nus su bzlas shing*/ spro na 'khor gyi sngags kyang bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas yum yab la thim/ de ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de yang de bzhin nyid kyi 'od gsal ba la zhugs te thams cad stong pa'i ngo bor gyur/ de nas bde ba chen po las sad pa'i phyir/ tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo lha mo bzhis bskul ba ni/ mā ma kīs/ sems can khams ni gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pa'i bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te bdag ni de ring gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ / spyan mas/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan ston pa/ /mgon po gal te bdag ni= 'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ / gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsungs te kun la phan/ /thugs brtse ba= /'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te bdag ni= /rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/

/yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po gal te= yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces bskul bas yab yum sngon bzhin du bzhengs par gyur/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba gsum khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal lam mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la= /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la= don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ / ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bru gsum gyis myang*/ snyoms 'jug gi bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga= sogs/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag nyid la thim/ gzhal yas khang yang rang lus la thim/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyis 'od zer spros te/ sems can rnams la dbang bskur bas sgrib gnyis sbyangs te hūṃ yig tu gyur nas nam mkha' gang*/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'chang du gyur pa bdag nyid kyi thugs kar thim/ spyi bor mtho gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la wa yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 'og tu oṃ mgo bo thur du bstan pas mtshan pa/ de las ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi byung ste spyi bo nas thim pas bdag gi lus rgyas par bsam/ rjes kyi bya ba ni gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /'dus pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus kho na'i rjes su 'brang ba grub chen tshul khrims mgon gyi ci bzhed pa ltar bkod pa'o/

/'dir smras pa/ bzhed pa mi 'dra bsgrigs pa la/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi mkhas rnams ngal/ /slob dpon gong ma'i byin rlabs kyi/ /rgyun la gnod pa ma byas sam/ / lung rgyun tsam yang mi bzhugs pa'i/ /glegs bam dag gi don bsgoms kyang*/ /glegs bam mthong bas khengs zhes pa'i/ /tshig de thog tu babs min nam/ /'dus pa'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te bzhi pa'o/ / sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs te he ru ka bsgom par 'dod pas/ sngon 'gro spyi dang 'dra/ snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ/ de'i 'od kyis he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dza/ ar+ghaṃ sogs yan lag lnga'am yan lag bdun pa'i rgyun bshags/ oṃ shu n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi/ de'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma la rang sems thig le dkar po re re de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon po sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po rdo rje/ g.yon dang dang po gri gug gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yas gnyis pa na thod pa bsnams pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ g.yas dang po rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ g.yon dang po thod pa/ gnyis pa ce spyang gi mgrin par bcir ba/ g.yas gnyis pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ dkar ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal/ g.yas dang po pad+ma/ g.yon dang po thod pa/ gnyis pa gzhu/ g.yas gnyis pa mda' bsnams pa'o/ /byang du sna tshogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu/ ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal/ g.yas dang po ral gri g.yon dang po zhags pa/ gnyis pas ka pā la/ g.yas gnyis pa na ḍā ma ru bsnams pa'o/ /de ltar lha mo bzhis/ e ma gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyis pad+ma rab phye zhig /a la la la la ho/ /bde ba chen pos rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig

/ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od kyi pad+ma rab kha 'byed pa bzhin/ /a la la la la ho/ bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /ces bskul bas thig le hūṃ/ de las rigs lnga'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros ye shes lnga la bkod/ tshur 'dus pa las dpal he ru ka sngon po sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i zhal phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams pas rang dang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma phyogs kyi gos can la 'khyud pa/ dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ khro chags mdzes shing sgeg pa'i rab tu khros shing 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ spyan gsum gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/ skra ser gyen brdzes/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ phyag rgya lnga dang*/ gar dgus rol pa/ thal chen gyis byugs shing mi lpags kyi stong g.yogs can/ g.yas brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis nyi ma'i steng du/ mi ro'i snying gar mnan pa me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lha mo lnga ni thal ba dang bral ba thod skam gyi 'phreng ba can no/ /rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mig tu a dkar po/ rna bar aḥ dmar po/ sna la khe dkar po/ mgrin par āḥ dmar po/ snying gar ra dmar po/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la rdo rje sngon po'i lte ba la hūṃ/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ dharma dhartu badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs de rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe= zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ gtso bo dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la rnam snang*/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ma la rin 'byung pad+ma ma la snang mtha'/ sna tshogs ma la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ thugs ka'i sa bon las mchod pa'i lha mo spros/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/

/sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / zhes bstod/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i mgo bor oṃ dkar po/ snying kar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang gnas su a dmar po/ brla gnyis su hā ljang khu/ mkha' gsang stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje/ oṃ las nor bu/ hrīḥlas pad+ma= a las ze'u 'bru'o/ /lha mo bzhis/ e ma gnyen mchog sogs kyis bskul bas/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal dang bcas snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas phaṭa kyis sgras/ sangs rgyas thams cad bkug te dhū tī'i lam nas pad+mar lhung ba'i bde ba byang chub kyi sems myang bar bsam/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ hūṃ/ zhes bzlas par bya/ bsdu ba ni spyi dang mthun no/ /zhes pa'ang grub chen ku ku ri pa'i gzhung che ba ji lta ba bzhin gyi nyams len grub chen tshul khrims mgon gyi man ngag ji lta ba bzhin no/ / 'dir smras pa/ lugs 'di spyod pa nyung ba'i phyir/ /bsre slad byas pa'ang shin tu nyung*/ /'on kyang nyog po'i tshig spangs nas/ /nyung ngu rnam gsal ngo mtshar che/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i mngon rtogs kyi skabs te lnga'o/ / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po bsgom par 'dod pas/ rang gi snying gar hūṃ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros/ phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad dang bcas pa gyur/ 'od zer de'i bdag dang sems thams cad sbyangs/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ yan lag bdun pa'am lnga pa gang rung bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang*/ sogs tshad med bzhi bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra gur me ri dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor du gyur/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/

dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa zhu ba las chos 'byung du gyur/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte bar pad nyi'i steng du/ bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo'i lte bar zla ba baṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang snang yum dang bcas pa zhu ba las/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus su sngo ba'i steng du rdo rje rwa ba zlum pos bskor ba rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris pas re mig dgu pa*/ 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa/ lte ba la rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyi ma'i gdan/ shar gyi rwa dbus ma dang shar lho'i grar zla ba/ gzhan lha'i gnas bcur nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ rang nyid zla ba la dhi las 'jam dpal gzhon nu dkar po rdo rje dril bu'am/ dmar ser pod ral gri 'dzin pa/

gang rung bskyed/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ de'i 'od zer gyis gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te bdag nyid zla ba dang bcas pa de thams cad nyi ma la thim/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i 'od zer gyis 'phro 'du las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid 'jigs mdzad nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ rtsa ba'i zhal ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis khro bo'i rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pas ma he'u steng du las kyi gshin rje yab yum dang bcas mnan pa*/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na zhugs par gyur/ oṃ dharma dha tu sogs spro na 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa dang yan lag drug pa bkod/ dbang bskur rnams kyang bya'o/ / yum gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ snying gar hūṃ nag po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang bar āḥ dmar po/ brla la ha ljang gu 'od zer sna lngas khyab pa/ hūṃ las yab kyi rdo rje oṃ las byung ba'i nor bus mtshan pa/ hrīḥlas yum gyi pad+ma a las byung ba'i ze'u 'brus mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga ho dmar pos bkag pa/ oṃ a nu rā ga ya mi/ rjes su chags par byas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga sogs/ zhes snyoms par zhugs par bsam ste dang por sbyor ba'o/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba lha mo'i pad+mar byung ba'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa dang*/ cha gcig cha bcu bdun du gyur pa/ yak+ṣe ya me da/ dza sa do ru/ yats+tsha ṇi ra/ ṇa yo ni ra rnams su gyur/

dbus kyi ya las rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa drug par rang gi thugs kar drangs/ yi ge bcu pa dang*/ badz+ra dh+rika thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ zhe sdang thams cad sbyangs/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus nas bdag nyid la thim pas/ bdag nyid sprul pa'i sku rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa ni/ dus mtha'i sprin ltar sku mdog nag / zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum/ / g.yon brkyang rnam par 'gying ba'i bzhugs sogs nas/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ / zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma ltar las/ bcom ldan de la 'khyud pa'i yum/ /dmar mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan mgo phreng can/ /lang tsho dar babs skra ser 'khyil/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis yab la 'khyud/ /de ltar rdo rje phag mo ni/ / 'jam dpal khros dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar gyi k+ṣe las gti mug gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i sogs/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oṃ dzi na dzika thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ gti mug can sbyangs/ gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar gyi re mig la 'khod/ lho'i ma las phra ma gshin rje gshed ser po ser nag dkar ba'i= rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oṃ rat+na dhika thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ phra ma can sbyangs/ phra ma gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus lho'i re mig la 'khod/ nub tu me las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i sogs rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oṃ a ro lika thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ 'dod chags can sbyangs/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub kyi re mig la 'khod/ byang gi da las phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i sogs/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/

pradz+nyā dh+rika thugs ka nas phyir phyung/ phrag dog can sbyangs/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang gi re mig la bkod/ shar lho'i dza las lha mo tsartsi ka gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu thugs kar drangs/ oṃ mo hi rā ti/ badz+ra tsa rtsi ka 'am/ thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ sa'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus me mtshams kyi grar 'khod/ lho nub kyi sa las phag mo ser mo dbu'i steng du phag zhal gyen du blta ba dang bcas pa phra ma gshin rje gshed lta bu/ thugs kar drangs/ oṃ dwe ṣa rwa ti thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ chu'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus bden bral gyi grar 'khod/ nub byang gi do las dbyangs can ma dmar mo 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu thugs kar drangs/ oṃ ra ga rā ti thugs kar= me'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rlung mtshams kyi grar 'khod/ byang shar gyi ru las gā+au rī ljang sngon phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu/ thugs kar drangs/ oṃ badz+ra rā ti thugs kar= rlung khams= tshur 'dus dbang ldan gyi= phyi rol gyi shar sgo ya las tho ba gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phrag drug gi sogs/ 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thugs kar drangs/ oṃ mut+ga dhṛka thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ tshangs pa dang dbang po dang me lha'i gdon gyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus shar sgor gyi grwar 'god/ lho'i tsa las dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar= oṃ rat+na dhṛka= gshin rje srin po'i gdon= lhor sgor= nub kyi ṇi las pad+ma gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i= oṃ pad+ma dhṛka= lha ma yin dang chu dang rlung lha'i gdon= nub sgor= byang gi ra las ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i= oṃ khat+ga dhṛka= gnod sbyin dang 'byung po'i= byang sgor= 'khor rnams rgyan cha lugs bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs shing*/ 'on kyang lha mo bzhi ni/

bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba'i rang snang gi thabs la 'khyud pa'o/ / rim pa gnyis pa'i gra bzhir/ ṇa yo ni ra rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ thod pa bzhir gyur te phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi rim pa gnyis pa'i gra bzhir 'khod/ gzhal yas khang rang gi thugs kar drangs/ phyir byung snod kyi 'jig rten gyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus phyi'i gzhal yas khang la thim/ rang gi snying gar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu gsum pa/ dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ut+ga ra dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa/ rat+na dhṛka hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa/ khat+ga dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bgegs bskrad/ yi ge bcu pas bsrung ba byas la/ oṃ mut+ga ra dza/ daṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ pad+ma baṃ/ khat+ga hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ro gcig tu gyur/ lha thams cad kyi/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar sa snying dngos/ /rna bar phyag rdor dz+riṃ nag po/ /sna la khaṃ ser nam mkha'i snying*/ /lce la gaṃ dmar 'jig rten dbang*/ / dpral ba sgrib sel skaṃ ljang khu/ /lte bar kun bzang saṃ sngon po/ /dpral bar sku'i rdo rje oṃ/ /mgrin par gsung gi rdo rje āḥ thugs kar thugs kyi rdo rje hūṃ/ / sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta swa bha wa ut+ma ko3haṃ/ thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa bsgom/ de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ 'di rnams gong du byas na 'dir mi dgos so/ / rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ ho gshin rje gshed nag po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/

khyod mthong kho bo rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs/ khyod kyi gar gyis sa steng dang*/ /sa bla dang ni sa 'og spyod/ / añca na nag bcas 'dra ba'i/ /gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs lags/ /sku lus sbom thung nag pa ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs sprul pa/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis btud/ /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che/ /hriḥṣ+ti'i gsang sngags dag gis khyod/ /sa gsum po yi 'khrul ba sel/ /snying rje khros pa rje btsun khyod/ /gar mdzad 'gro ba yongs la gzigs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas bdud rtsa myang la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ ya ma ra dza sa do me ya ya me du ru/ na yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe yets+tsha ni ra ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsa sngags so/ / oṃ hrīḥṣ+ti bi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ / snying po'o/ / oṃ ya man+ta ka hūṃ phaṭaḥ ye ge drug pa nye snying ngo*/ / oṃ a kro te ka ya man+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañja hūṃ phaṭa/ las sngags so/ /de ltar bzlas pa byas la/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag la thim/ bdag nyid kyang ye shes sems pa la/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de yang 'od gsal du nye bar zhugs/ rjes kyi bya ba thams cad spyi dang mthun no/ /zhes pa slob dpon ka ma la rak+ṣi ta'i gzhung las phal che bar bstan pa/ /grub chen khyung po dz+wa ki'i man ngag ji lta ba'i lugs so/ / 'dir smras pa/ 'ga' zhig rgya gzhung khungs tshol zhing*/ /dkyi' 'khor mchog 'di bsgom pa 'gog /ma mthong ba la med ces pa'i/ /tshig 'di'ang dub pa yin ces gsung*/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi skabs te drug pa'o/ / ༈ da ni cung zad cig dpyad par bya ste/ phyi ma'i dus 'dir sngags la mkhas par rlom pa mang po zhig log par rtog la 'di dang 'di lta bu sems par byed de/ dkyil 'khor lnga po 'di dag phyogs gcig tu 'god pa'ang mi rung na lus dkyil la 'god pa ga la zhig snyam pa dang*/

'di lus la bkod pa'i lha yin gyi lus dkyil ma yin no snyam pa dang*/ lus la bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga char la / so sor yan lag bzhi rdzogs ma byas na/ dkyil 'khor de dang bsgom pa'i go mi chod snyam pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gcig gis lngar dbang bskur mi rung snyam pa dang*/ lha skad cig gis bsgom pa thams cad rdzogs rim kho na'i skabs yin nam snyam pa dang*/ skye shi bar do gsum so sor sbyong byed kyi dmigs pa ma tshang na sgom du mi rung bar 'dod pa dang*/ kye rdo rje mtshan cha can bcu bdun nam mi 'thad snyam pa dang*/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mi 'thad pa'am/ 'thad du chug kyang lha dang cho ga ma 'khrul bar med par 'dod pa rnams so/ / de dag gis lan ni mtha' yas par yod mod/ rgyas par mi spro ste snyigs ma'i dus kyi gang zag rnams/ rang lugs kyi bla ma shes rab kyi rnam dpyod 'khyogs pa dang ldan zhing*/ nus mthu dang thugs rje mngon du gyur pa ni til 'bru tsam dang bral ba 'ga' zhig gtso bor byas te/ rigs pa dang mi rigs pa'i brtags dpyad gtong long med par grub mtha' skyo ma snga btsan la zhen pas kun nas bslangs te zhe sdang me bzhin 'bar nas sbyor ba ngan pa kun tu rtsom pa tsam ma gtogs/ log rtog bzlog par mi byed par snang bas so/ /mu stegs pa rnams kyang rigs pa la yid rton par byed na/ da lta bod kyi mkhas rlom 'di dag ni phyugs dang mtshungs pa nyid do/ /'on kyang lugs 'di la mos pa rnams la nges par byed pa'i phyir du/ snying po tsam zhig brjod na/ dkyil 'khor lnga phyogs gcig tu 'god mi rung ste/ de ltar ston pa'i lung gi khungs med cing*/ rgyud sde tha dad nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor phyogs gcig tu 'god pa yang rang bzo yin no snyam du bsam pa'o/ / 'dir smras pa/ khyed kyi lugs la lung de ci/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa nyid yin nam/

khyed kyis mthong ba la byed/ phyi ma ltar na khyed rnams byis pa chung ngu'i skabs dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bzhag phra mo rnams dang*/ mdo rgyud kyi brda chad phal mo che rnams kyang lung khungs med la/ khyed rnams kyis phyis mthong ba na de yod par 'gyur ba sogs ha cang yang thal bar 'gyur ro/ / dang po ltar na ni/ sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud las bshad par bzhed de/ bzhed pa de la 'gog byed ci yod/ sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud ces pa gtan med pa'am/ gal te yod kyang de nas 'di ma bstan pa'i lung dang rigs pa rnam dag ci yod/ rgyud sde mang po'i lha'i mngon rtogs sna tshogs rgyud gcig tu bsdus te 'chad pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ bde mchog a bhi ta rna las sangs rgyas thod pa'i sgrub thabs sogs bshad pa dang*/ dus 'khor nas bde mchog gsang 'dus sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa dang*/ thog mar rgyud sde gnyis khog cig /yang de dag rgyud sde gzhan nas bshad pa'i lha ma yin gyis zhal phyag sogs cung zad mi 'dra ba'i phyir/ rgyud sde de nyid kyi lha yin no snyam na/ zhal phyag mi 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan de ci/ mdor byas dang lū yi pa sogs mi 'dra bas so snyam na/ ye shes zhabs lugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs sogs kyang so so'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /rigs pa 'di mngon rtogs dang cho ga'i rim pa dang yang mtshungs so/ / yang cig tu na kho bo cag gi dkyil 'khor 'di yang sdom pa rgya mtsho'i de kho na'i dkyil 'khor yin zhes brjod na ci zhig smras/ yang khyed kyi lugs la/ a bhi dha na nas bshad pa'i sangs rgyas thod pa de yang rnam par ma dag ste/ thod pa'i rgyud da lta'i 'di nas ni de ma bshad/ ma rgyud rgyas par ni da lta ma mthong bas lung gi khungs med do zhes bskur ba 'debs dgos par 'gyur ro/

/yang kha cig dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i bde gsang la sogs pa rgyud sde rgyas pa nas bshad pa yin no/ / zhes smra bar byed do/ / de ltar na dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus gnyis rgyud sde tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud sde tha dad mang po'i dkyil 'khor rgyud sde gcig nas gsungs pa yang yod par 'grub bo/ /yang rang bzo zhes bya ba ci la zer/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa med pa'o snyam na/ kho bo cag la ni de yod par 'dod cing*/ rgya gar gyi grub chen dngos la thug pa'i khyung po rnal 'byor pas 'di'i sgrub thabs che chung gnyis mdzad cing*/ bla ma rnams kyi lo rgyus kyi yi ge kun la yang 'di'i dbang bskur ba sogs kyi gtam rgyud du mar byung zhing*/ chig brgyud kyi bka' brgya grol nas ni lag len rgyun ma chad pa 'di'o/ / yang bshad pa'i*/ khungs gsal kha med pa la rang bzo cis zer na ni/ bir+wa ba'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa gdam ngag zab mo mtha' yas pa zhig dang*/ bod phyi rabs pa la ni/ bla ma dbu ma pa'i 'jam dbyangs chos skor la sogs pa ston byed kyi rgyu dang rgya gzhung gang na yod/ de lta bas na rang bzo ni khyed cag rnams la thog tu bab ste brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la/ kha cig rang lugs ma yin ces pa dang*/ kha cig la lhag chad nor ba'i skyon yod ces skyon btang ste/ rang gi dbang zhus pa'i bla ma de lag len de lta bu byed pa lta zhog thos pa tsam yang med par/ rang nyid kyi rgyud 'grel pa dang rgya gzhung tha na lung rgyun tsam yang med pa rnams kyi don phyogs gcig tu dril nas/ rang yang bsgom zhing gzhan la yang ston par byed do/ /de'i byin rlabs dang lag len gyi rgyun yod 'phro la chad nas/

zhi gnas skyon can tsam yang rgyud la mi skye shing*/ byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma sna gcig kyang med par nyin bsam mtshan bsam kho na 'das shing tshig gis bshad pas/ mi'i mngon du lus kyi spyod pa'i mdzes 'khrigs dang*/ zhing ma yin pa rgyal po la sogs pa rnams la ngo dga'i khyogs la sogs pa'i bya bas rang phyogs tsam dar ba la bstan pa skyong bar sems pa 'di mtshar ro/ / yang rgya gzhung sogs kyi khungs gtso bor byed na ni/ phyi rabs kyi mkhas rlom rnams kyis byas pa'i sgrub dkyil rnams ni/ rgya bod kyi yi ge thams cad bsres te 'dor len 'ba' zhig byed kyi/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub tshad ldan dang*/ bod kyi mkhas pa dang sgrub pa po tshad dang ldan pa su'i lugs dang mi mthun par byed do/ /dgyes mdzad kyi sku la bde gsang sogs 'god pa yang mi rigs pa ma yin te/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i sku la bde mchog gi lha tshogs bkod pa'i lus dkyil a bhi da na rus gsungs pa yin no/ / yang slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa pu n+yā shris mdzad pa'i dkyil chog dkyil 'khor lnga char gcig bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor cho ga yod pa'i phyir/ rgya gzhung gi khungs med pa'ang ga la yin/ de nyid slob dpon des mdzad pa ma yin no snyam na'ang/ de'i rgyu mtshan ci/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog phyogs gcig tu glegs bam du byas pa rnams la mi bzhugs pas so snyam na/ de 'dra ba'i ma nges pa/ chen po de dpyod ldan su zhig smra/ sngon 'gyur nges pa bstan 'gyur bsdu ba po rnams kyis ma rnyed pa yang yod la/ slad kyi 'gyur ba yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsod pa dang bcas pa rnams ni gang rgyu mtshan du yang mi rung ste/ theg pa chen po nyid kyang rang sde'i rtsod pa can yin pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa'i lan ni/ /yang lus dkyil gyi lha dang*/ lus la bkod pa'i lha tsam la khyad par yod pa ni kho bo cag kyang 'dod de dkyil 'khor du byas pa dang*/

ma byas pa'i lha'i khyad par nyid do/ /'on kyang gsang 'dus 'phags skor dang bde mchog /li nag dril gsum lta bu'i lus dkyil gyi mtshan nyid lus thams cad nges par tshang dgos pa ni ma yin te/ lus dkyil la rtsa khams lhar bskyed pa dang*/ phung khams bskyed pa gnyis yod la/ de las gzhan med par gang nas kyang ma bshad cing gzhan du na/ 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi lus dkyil de yang*/ bde mchog nas bshad pa'i lus dkyil gyi mtshan nyid mi snang ba'i phyir/ lus dkyil rnam par dag pa ma yin no zhes smra dgos par 'gyur ro/ / gzhan yang rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i tshe/ snying ga'i dkyil 'khor la bdag 'jug byed pa yod cing*/ de la bla med 'ga' zhig dang mtshungs pa'i lus dkyil kyi sgrub gzhir byed pa ni med la/ snying ga'i dkyil 'khor yin pa'i phyir dang*/ snying ga de lus ma yin ci zhig yin/ gzhan lus dkyil gyi lha la sgrub gzhi lus yin pas khyab par smra ba shin tu ma brtags pa yin te/ rang nyid kyi lus dkyil mchog tu 'bad pas sgrub pa'i 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi lus dkyil de la/ sgrub gzhi tshor ba'i phung po las byas pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ sgrub gzhi rnam shes kyi phung po la byas pa'i mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de dag /sgrub gzhi lus la yin pa'i phyir/ lus dkyil gyi lha ma yin par 'dod dgos te/ phung po bzhi po de dag lus su khas blangs pa'i skabs nam yang med pa'i phyir ro/ / de bas na lugs 'di skyongs pa'i phyi rabs pa 'ga' zhig 'khor lo lnga'i lha rtsa khams de yongs su gyur pa las/ dkyil 'khor lngar bsgom pa zhig ma byung na/ der de dag 'god pa tsam gyis lus dkyil du mi 'gyur zhes smras pa'ang*/ snying po med do/ /de bas na lus la bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gang yin pa de dag thams cad lus kyi dkyil 'khor du ming don mthun du 'jug pa la ci zhig rgol/

gzhan du na 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la yang khyed cag rtsod par byed dam/ de bas na phyis byung ba byis pa'i rtsod pa 'di dag ni smig rgyu dang mtshungs par mngon no/ /log rtog gsum pa yang phyis byung ba'i lugs 'di 'dzin pa phal che ba zhig dang*/ gzhan lugs pa kha cig kyang ste/ sa bon las bskyed cing so so'i lugs kyi go cha 'god pa dang*/ so sor ye shes pa bstims pa dang rang rang gi rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pa rnams byas na/ dkyil 'khor so so'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa re bsgom par 'gyur la/ gzhan du dkyil 'khor lnga po bsgom pa'i go mi chod snyam pa yin mod kyi/ lus dkyil thams cad la yan lag bzhi rdzogs dgos pas ma khyab ste/ lū nag dril gsum gyi lus dkyil ni sa bon las mi bskyed pa yang shin tu mang la/ 'dus pa'i lus dkyil yang sa bon las ni bskyed mod kyi/ yan lag lhag ma rnams ni gtan bsgom par mi byed pa bzhin no/ / gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang 'phreng bar/ dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gcig gnyis la skad cig gis bskyed de yan lag lhag ma rnams kyang mi byed pa'i sgrub thabs kyang mdzad na/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor la de dag dgos pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'on te de bskyed rim gyi skabs ma yin gyi/ rdzogs rim gyi bskyed tshul yin no zhes smra ba dang*/ kha cig ltar bskyed rim la bstan pa thob pa rnal 'byor bzhi pa'i skabs la bsgom par bya ba yin gyi/ las dang po la des bskyed pa'i rim pas go mi chod snyam na/ de nyid kyi sngon du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ tshogs zhing mchod cing rgyun bshags byed pa sogs bshad pas rdzogs rim gyi lha bsgom pa'i yan lag tu/ de dag dgos par 'dod pa las ngo mtshar che ba ci zhig yod/ bzhi pa'i lan ni/ re zhig khyed cag nyid la 'dri ste/

gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa gang la/ 'dus pa rtsa bshad nas bshad pa 'ba' zhig bya dgos sam/ rgyud sde gzhan nas bshad pas rung*/ dang po ltar na ni/ de ltar khyed rnams kyi lag len byed pa rnams smos kyang ci dgos/ tshad dang ldan par gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa dang/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa la sogs pa de dag kyang khyed kyi lugs la shin tu 'khrul bar thal bar gyur te/ de dag gi cho ga mang po rgyud sde gzhan nas drangs par mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rgya bod na cho ga rnam par dag pa sna gcig kyang med par khas blangs par song bas rang nyid la co 'bri bar byas so/ / gnyis pa ltar na rgyud sde sna tshogs nas bsdus pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gcig gis 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur du rung zhing*/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur du mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang dag pa gcig kyang mi snang ngo*/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis zhal snga nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'phreng ba zhes bya ba yang*/ rgyud sde mtha' dag nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la cho ga gcig kho na sbyar ba yin pas re zhig de nyid khog la/ phyis 'di dgag par gyis shig /de lta mod kyi man ngag dang khungs med par phan tshun gcig gis rang bzo'i rgyas 'geb pa kho bo cag ni rmi lam na yang mi byed mod/ bla med kyi cho ga yang dag la kyai rdo rje'am/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'dres byed cing*/ bde mchog dang 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim mang po la yang*/ lam skor gyi brda chad 'dres par yang snang*/ la la dag ni rdzogs rim thams cad gnad bzhi dang bsre ba dgu la sogs pa sbyor ba dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs pa zhal phyag dag pa'i nges don du byas na rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod kyi rna bar ma thos pa'i khrid sna tshogs pa zab zab ltar bcos nas ma rgyud kyi 'pho ba bsnan te rgya cher 'chad pa'i phyir khyed rnams nyid kyis gzab dgos

so/ / log rtog lnga pa ni/ 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa la sogs pa skad cig gis bskyed pa ji snyed cig byung zhing*/ brgyud pa'i srol 'di la yang skad cig gis bskyed pa la nyams len gyi gtso bor mdzad de/ de la bod kha cig gis bla ma'i man ngag med par rang gi blo bzo ma skad cig gis bsgom pa'i mngon rtogs dang*/ de'i dbang chog sogs gsar du brtsams pa dag byung ba la/ rang bzo'i krong bskyed bsgom du mi rung zhes chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas 'gog par mdzad pa yin mod kyi/ krong bskyed thams cad bkag pa ga la yin/ de bas phyi ma'i dus 'dir skad cig gis bskyed pa rdzogs rim gyi lha 'ba' zhig tu 'dod pa dang*/ bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor bzhi pa'i skabs kho na'i bsgom bya yin par 'dod pa ni gtso bo'i don la mtshungs te/ bskyed rim rnal 'byor bzhi pa yang rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa bzang po ma skyes pa la 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de la 'di ltar btags te/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs ma yin par lha skad cig gis bskyed pa gtan nas mi rung ba'am/ spyir rung du chug kyang de 'ba' zhig la sems 'dzin du mi rung ba'o/ /de yang rung du chug mod kyi sa bon la sogs pa las bskyed pa gzhan zhig med par/ krong bskyed kyi lha 'ba' zhig bsgom pa mi rung ba yin/ dang po ltar na gsang 'dus 'phags skor gyi lhag mos dang*/ thun mtshams kyi lha bskyed pa yang mi rung bar 'gyur zhing*/ gnyis pa ltar na yang de ltar mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan cung zad kyang med pa kho nar ma zad bskyed rim la sems 'dzin pa'i tshe gzhan du cung zad sems yengs pa na slar yang mngon rtos mgo nas ma bcad par sems 'dzin du mi rung bar 'gyur ro/ /des na sems gzhan du yengs pa na slar sems 'dzin pa'i tshe skad cig gis bskyed pa las 'os ci yod/ gsum pa ltar na mi rung zhes bya ba ni ci zhig

/'ga' zhig thun mtshams kyi lha tsam bsgom ste/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa mi byed/ de dag la mi rung ba med na/ thun bzhi'i lha skad cig gis bskyed pa la sems gnas pa brtan por byed pa dang*/ de'i sngags bzla ba la skyon du blta ba ni/ skyes bu zhig tshong dus kyi lam du nye bar zhugs pa la yang na khyod ma 'gro/ ci ste 'gro na 'khor yug gi pha rol tu 'gro dgos so zhes smra ba dang mi mtshungs sam/ rang gi blo dang 'tsham pa/ de tsam bsgom pa la skyon du ma 'dzin zhig / log rtog drug pa ni/ bod kyi phyi rabs pa 'ga' zhig la snang ste/ skye shi bar do gsum sbyong byed so sor tshang zhing*/ sku gsum lam byed so sor yod pa zhig bsgom na/ rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gyur zhing bag chags de dang de sbyongs pa'i nus pa yod cing*/ mngon rtogs bsdus pa re la zab mor bsgom pa rnam pa rnams ni snying po med pa la brtson par byed pas dus don med du 'da'o/ /zhes smra bar byed do/ /tshig 'di ni shin tu mi rung ba yin te/ chos dang gang zag dam pa mtha' yas pa zhig la ngan smras su song ba'i phyir ro/ /yang ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka sogs grub pa'i skyes bu ji snyed pa zhig gis mdzad pa bde dgyes gsang 'dus dus 'khor gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs mtha' yas pa zhig mdzad pa ma yin nam/ yang sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'di dag gis skye shi bar do'i sa bon dngos su 'joms mi nus pas sgom du mi rung ba yin na ni/ shin tu ma nges te de lta na bskyed rim mtha' dag dang*/ so so'i skye bo'i lam gyi rdzogs rim thams cad kyis sa bon de rnams dngos su 'joms mi nus pa'i phyir bsgom du mi rung bar 'gyur la rgyud nas de rnams 'joms pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang smon lam btab pa tsam yang 'gyur na/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa rnams kho nas nyes pa ci zhig byas/

gzhan yang dus gsum gyi snang ba lhar bsgom pa kho nas tha mal gyi snang zhen yin no cog thams cad mgo non par 'gyur na/ skye shi bar do gsum kho nas snang zhen log zhig tu ci la sdod/ don gyi gtso bo yang tha mal gyi snang zhen bzlog pa yin pa'i phyir bskyed rim gyi gtso bo'i don sgrub thabs bsdus pa rnams la yang tshang ba yin no/ /sku gsum lam du byed mi nus pa zhes pa la yang rigs pa 'di nyid sbyar bar bya'o/ /ci ste sku gsum lam byed dang*/ srid pa gsum sbyong byed tsam yod du chug kyang*/ bsdus pa de dag mi zab cing rgyas pa de dag zab snyam na/ 'di la ni gang zag gi khyad par shes dgos te/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa gsal thebs shing mngon rtogs rgyas pa de yang myur du bsgom thub pa'i gang zag la ni rgyas pa de dag shin tu zab pa yin pa kho bo cag kyang 'dod mod/ de lta bu'i gang zag ni shin tu nyung ste/ dkyil 'khor de'i ngor gsal thebs dgos kyi/ mngon rtogs 'don shes pa dang go ba yod pa tsam gyis mi chog pa'i phyir ro/ /des na zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'am/ gtso rkyang tsam 'ol spyi gsal thebs la/ dkyil 'khor chen po bsgom pa'i tshai 'ol spyi tsam yang gsal thebs dka' ba sha stag 'dug ste/ mngon rtogs chen po 'don cing bsgom pa ltar bcos nas nyin zhag brgya stong 'das kyang mngon rtogs rgyas pa lan cig tsam yang*/ tshang bar gsal thebs dka' zhing*/ ngag gi nus pa rnyed pa dang sems gnas thob cig kyang mi yong ba'i tshod du snang bas/ gang zag de la mi zab bo/ /des na de la ni nyung ngu tsam bsgom na gsal yang thebs la/ bsgom bzlas mang du byas pas mthu nus pa yang rnyed/ sems zin sla bas mi ring bar gsal snang mched nas/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bsgom pa'i skal pa can du yang 'gyur bas na/ gang zag 'di la ni mngon rtogs kyang bsdus pa rnams zab pa yin no/ / 'o na/ bsdus pa de rnams dbang po rtul bo'i nyams len du snang bas/

mi zab par grub pa'i phyir kho bo cag rgyas pa bsgom mo snyam na/ lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis po yang gsal mi thebs bzhin du dbang po rnon po'i nga rgyal mi 'tshal zhing*/ khyed cag dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bsgom pa la ni kho bo cag dgag pa brjod pa dang ngan par ga la sems te/ de tsam gyis kyang bag chags khyad par can 'jog par snang bas so/ /'on kyang da lta gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs par sems pa rnams ni/ re re tsam ma gtogs dbang po rtul por snang ba'i phyir dbang po mchog dman gyi khrid lugs shes dgos so/ / log rtog bdun pa ni kha cig na re/ slob dpon ka ma la pas sam+bu ṭa'i snying po he ru ka bcu bdun pa'i dkyil 'khor mtshan ma bzhi bor nas/ de'i phyag mtshan sgo ma bzhi gtad nas bcu gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'dod de/ rgyud las/ pi waṃ dang ni gling bu dang*/ /ku mud dag dang rdza rnga ste/ / phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /zhes bshad pa dang*/ 'gal lam snyam na/ 'di khyung po rnal 'byor gyi kyai rdor mtshon cha can zer te/ rgyud 'grel rnams nas de'i tha snyad ma bshad do/ /zhes 'dri ste/ de la smras pa/ khyed ni grags pa dang ldan pa zhes kyang snang ste/ smra ba 'di lta bu la ci'i phyir 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ dgos pa med bzhin du rigs pa ma yin pa'i tshig gi chos dang gang zag mchog la sdang ba'i sdig pa rngam po che bsags pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba lwa ba'i na bza' can lta bu la skyon 'dzin pa 'di lta bu'i snying khams ni nam mkhar mi shong ba tsam ste/ de lta bur na grub chen mtsho skyes kyis bstod pa dang sgrub thabs las/ sha ra bha dang byi la'i dod du khyi dang ma he bshad pa yang rgyud dang mi mthun ces khog cig nyi zer la chibs pa sogs kyi cho 'phrul la mnga' brnyes shing*/ shing gi lha mos bsod snyoms 'bul sogs kyi rtags las dngos grub brnyes nges pa/

rang gi brgyud pa'i bla ma bka' drin can/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po dpa' bo rdo rje ni zhabs kyis bzhugs stangs skabs rgyud dang mi mthun zhes khyed nyid kyis bkag zin to/ /khyung po'i dgyes mdzad ces gsungs pa'i ming tsam gyis yang khungs mi chod cing*/ mtshon cha can gyi tha snyad khungs med zer bzhin du rang yang de ltar brda chad byed pa ni shin tu blun no/ /kyai rdor gyi rgyud da lta'i 'brog mi'i 'gyur gsum po 'di ma gtogs gzhan shes bya la mi rigs cing*/ zhal gzigs dang man ngag sogs kyi sgrub thabs gtan byed du mi rung na ni khyed kyi de bden bden 'dra'o/ /de lta na ni bir+wa pa'i gshed dmar sgrub thabs kyang rgyud 'di dang mi mthun ces dgag dgos par 'gyur/ rgyud 'grel nas ma bshad pa kho nas rnam dag ma yin par 'gyur na bkag chog dang*/ mgon po dang lha mo la sogs pa'i rang nyid nyams su len pa du ma zhig la co 'dri bar gyur la/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma dang phag dkar/ shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs sogs kyang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ bde mchog gi rgyud 'grel rnams nas ma bshad pa'i phyir/ brda chad kyang rgyud 'grel nas bshad pa dgos na/ lam 'bras gdams ngag tu nyams lnga gsum bco lnga dang grub brgyad mnyen lcug bzhi la sogs pa thams cad mi 'thad par thal bar 'gyur te rgyud 'grel rnams na de 'dra'i tha snyad ma bshad pas so/ /de dag grub chen rgya gzhung khungs yod pas so snyam na/ dgyes mdzad bcu gsum yang rgya gzhung gi khungs yod pa dang*/ phyogs 'dir skye bo phal mo che'i sngon du rdzu 'phrul dpag med ston pa sogs grub rtags mngon gyur can/ rgya gar gyis paṇ+ḍi ta lnga bcu'i rjes su bzung ba'i mkhas grub 'di nyid kyis gang gsungs pa de nyid las zab par bzang ba'i khungs ci zhig 'tshal/ kho bo cag ni rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung zhing lung bstan pa bar dor mchog brnyes pa nges pa/

mdo sngags gzhung lugs rig gnas thams cad la cher mkhas pa/ rgyud chen po sum brgya thugs nas gsungs pa'i rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a bha yas gsungs pa kyai rdo rje bdud bzhi bkram gdan pa la sogs 'di thams cad skyon du ga la 'dzin/ log rtog brgyad pa bsal ba ni/ 'di na mi mkhas kyang mkhas su re ba/ 'ga' zhig 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mi 'thad de/ rgya gzhung gi khungs med pa'i phyir dang*/ lha rnams mnga' 'byin byed pa yang 'jigs byed la yum med par bshad pa dang 'gal ba yin zhes mang du smra zhing yi ge 'bri bar byed do/ /tshul 'di la dpyod ldan rnams kyi sa mang du brgal lan byas pa yang yod cing*/ rgyas par gzhan du 'dri bar 'gyur bas 'dir mi brjod do/ /'on kyang slob dpon chen po ka ma la rak+ṣis tas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyang yod la/ spyir khungs yod med kyi dpyad pa ni gong dang mtshungs so/ /'jigs byed la yum byar mi rung ba'i lung tshig gsal kha med la/ yum yod pa byar mi rung ste sgrub thabs phal cher na med pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ de lta na bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs kyang mi rung ste/ sgrub thabs phal cher na yum yod par bshad pa'i phyir ces dang mi mtshung ngam/ des na rgol ba de la ni snying po ma mchis so/ /

'jigs byaid bcu gsum ma mchog tu 'dod pa rnams kyang dang por zhal gsum pa bskyed/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi tshe zhal dgu par bsgyur ba ni mi 'thad par 'dod pa yang gong du bshad pa'i yum 'gog byed kyi rigs pa dang mtshungs so/ /gtso bo'i yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byed pa mi 'thad snyam pa yang de dang 'dra la khyad par phag mo ser mo byed pa ni mi rung zhes pa ni/ gshin rje gshed nag po dang 'di mtshungs dgos pa las/ gshed nag gi dkyil 'khor la ni phag mo sngon mor yod pa'i phyir snyam pa'o/ / gshin rje dgra nag gi dkyil 'khor yin na de ni 'thad du chug kyang*/ dgra nag dang phyogs mthun tsam bkod pa ma gtogs rgyud tha dad pa yin pa'i phyir ma nges la/ phyogs tsam ni gshed dmar dang yang mthun cing*/ de ni phag mo ser mo yang bshad do/ /spyir phag mo mā ma ki'i ngo bo yin la/ de ni mi bskyod pa dang rin 'byung gnyis ka'i rigs bstan pa yin par rgyud sde phal mo che la grags pa yin pas/ kha dog kyang gnyis ka ltar rung bar mngon cing*/ khyad par ka ma la rak+ṣi ti'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba yin no/ /de lta bas na bskyed rim gyi lam bzang po lugs srol mchog 'di la yid gnyis dang log rtog gi dbang du ma gyur par gus pa chen pos nan du byos shig / 'dir smras pa/ yid bzhin rin chen 'dam rdzab kyis gos blun po rnams kyis spangs gyur pa/ / nor bu mkhan mchog blo ldan mkhas pas nyer blangs rang gzhan don ston byed/ /blun pos blangs na chud 'dzar gyur bas re zhig bor ba nyid ni mchog /nya pa'i tshogs kyis rin chen rnyed pa'ang phye mar brdung ste bor la ltos/ /blun po mkhas par 'chos gang de rnams kyis/ /tshad mar byas gang bsre bslad mang pos khyab/ /de dag rnams kyis bor gang lam mchog 'di/ /nyes skyon dri ma bral gang ngo mtshar rmad/ /rigs pas sgrub pa'i skabs te bcu bdun pa'o/

/ 'bras bu lam byed bde ba chen po'i rgyud/ /mthar thug ston byed rgyud rgyal rnam pa lnga'i/ / sgrub thabs kun ni mchog gyur zla bral ba/ /smra ba gang de zla med dpa' bo yin/ /sangs rgyas kuna~X gyi dkyil 'khor che/ spyod 'chang dga~X' ba'i bde sgrub pas/ /snyinga~X po ༵ mchog 'di sems can kun/ / rdo rje 'dzin chen rgyal gyur cig / rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bskyed rim mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i chos kyi rigs rus su skyes pa tā ra nā thas snga phyi bskul ba po mang po dang*/ nye bar dad ldan grags pa bzang pos yi ge pa dang bskul ba po byas nas/ rgyas bsdus bsre slad sogs kyi skyon dang bral bar nye bar sbyar ba ste yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal stag lung thang gi dben gnas rnam rgyal rab brtan zhes bya ba'i gnas su'o// //'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang*/ khyad par grub chen shangs pa'i bka' srol gyi sgrub rgyud 'di nyid phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 96 - - PAGE 95 - - PAGE 1 - EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
